items.title: SpaceX旗下Cursor也用中國AI！為何如今考慮逐步停用？
items.title_en: SpaceX's Cursor Also Uses Chinese AI! Why Is It Now Considering Phasing It Out?
paras: 據《CNBC》周五(20日)報導，SpaceX(SPCX-US)旗下AI程式開發平台Cursor已向美國國會議員表示，正因「地緣政治風險」，考慮逐步停用中國開發的開放權重AI模型。Cursor先前以中國AI公司月之暗面(Moonshot AI)的Kimi K2.5為基礎，打造自家程式模型Composer 2，如今相關技術選擇成為美國國會關注焦點。
這項訊息來自美國眾議院國土安全委員會與中國問題特別委員會共同製作的報告。《CNBC》在報告預定周五公布前，獨家取得相關內容。

Cursor採用Kimi打造模型 向國會透露調整計畫

報告指出，Cursor已告知兩個委員會，將研議因應地緣政治風險，逐步停用中國開發的開放權重模型。目前這項調整仍處於研究階段，並未宣布全面停用或提出明確時程。
SpaceX今年6月宣布簽署收購Cursor的正式協議，並於8月完成交易，當時Cursor的隱含股權估值達600億美元。除了提供AI程式開發工具，Cursor也參與SpaceX旗下Grok系列模型的訓練。
這份報告歷經數月調查，檢視中國AI模型如何被納入美國企業的技術系統。除了Cursor，Airbnb(ABNB-US)與DoorDash(DASH-US)也就使用中國AI模型的情況，配合國會調查提供說明。
中國模型今年在全球的使用量快速增加。隨著模型能力提升，美中AI競爭也進一步延伸至企業採用、技術依賴與國家安全等層面。

低成本推動中國模型普及 國會建議擴大聯邦限制

報告認為，成本、客製化能力，以及接近頂尖模型的效能，是中國AI模型受到企業青睞的主要原因。相較之下，美國缺乏能在市場要求的價格與效能之間，提供競爭力的開放權重替代方案。
報告並警告，北京正試圖將這些技術進展轉化為全球市占率，以及使用者對中國模型的長期依賴。
為此，報告建議推動「美國國家級開放權重計畫」，整合公共運算資源、共用評測基礎設施，以及合法取得美國頂尖模型供訓練使用的管道。
報告也主張，在10月公開、禁止聯邦文職機關系統使用DeepSeek的命令基礎上，進一步禁止聯邦資訊系統，以及執行聯邦合約時使用中國開發的AI模型。
此外，華府也關注中國企業透過海外資料中心，遠端使用輝達(NVDA-US)晶片，以及利用「蒸餾」技術，藉既有模型協助訓練新模型的情況。美國商務部工業與安全局(BIS)已於本周一公布一項臨時最終規則，旨在阻止中國企業遠端取得AI晶片運算資源。
針對《CNBC》的置評要求，Cursor、SpaceX與DoorDash未回應，Airbnb拒絕評論；BIS、中國外交部及中國駐英國大使館也未提供回應。
paras_en: According to CNBC on Friday (the 20th), SpaceX's (SPCX-US) AI programming platform Cursor has told U.S. lawmakers that, due to "geopolitical risk," it is considering gradually discontinuing the use of open-weight AI models developed in China. Cursor previously built its own programming model Composer 2 based on Moonshot AI's Kimi K2.5, and this technology choice has now become a focus of congressional attention.

The information comes from a report jointly produced by the House Homeland Security Committee and the Special Committee on China. CNBC obtained the relevant content exclusively before the report’s scheduled Friday release.

The report notes that Cursor has informed the two committees that it will study how to respond to geopolitical risk by gradually phasing out Chinese-developed open-weight models. The adjustment is still in the research stage, with no announcement of a full shutdown or a clear timeline.

SpaceX announced in June that it had signed a definitive agreement to acquire Cursor, completing the transaction in August, at which time Cursor’s implied equity valuation was $60 billion. In addition to providing AI programming tools, Cursor also participates in training SpaceX’s Grok series models.

The report, compiled over several months, examined how Chinese AI models are being incorporated into U.S. companies’ technology stacks. Besides Cursor, Airbnb (ABNB-US) and DoorDash (DASH-US) also provided explanations to congressional investigators regarding their use of Chinese AI models.

Chinese models have seen a rapid increase in global usage this year. As model capabilities improve, the U.S.-China AI competition is extending into corporate adoption, technological dependence, and national security dimensions.

The report attributes the popularity of Chinese AI models among enterprises to low cost, customization ability, and performance close to top-tier models. By contrast, the U.S. lacks open-weight alternatives that can competitively balance price and performance in the market.
The report warns that Beijing is trying to turn these technological advances into global market share and to create long-term user dependence on Chinese models.

To address this, the report recommends launching a "U.S. National Open-Weight Initiative" that would integrate public computing resources, shared benchmarking infrastructure, and lawful channels to obtain top U.S. models for training use.

The report also advocates that, building on the October order prohibiting federal civilian agency systems from using DeepSeek, further bans be placed on federal information systems and on the use of Chinese-developed AI models in the performance of federal contracts.

Additionally, Washington is concerned about Chinese firms using overseas data centers to remotely access NVIDIA (NVDA-US) chips and employing "distillation" techniques to leverage existing models to train new ones. The Department of Commerce’s Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) announced a temporary final rule on Monday aimed at preventing Chinese companies from remotely obtaining AI chip computing resources.

When asked for comment by CNBC, Cursor, SpaceX and DoorDash did not respond, Airbnb declined to comment, and BIS, China’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and the Chinese embassy in the United Kingdom also provided no response.

items.title: 川普想把資料中心留在美國！美企赴海外興建恐遭禁或被課重稅
items.title_en: Trump Wants to Keep Data Centers in the U.S.! U.S. Companies Building Abroad May Face Ban or Heavy Tax
paras: 據《CNBC》報導，美國總統川普周五(20日)在白宮記者會上表示，他打算禁止美國企業在海外興建資料中心，或對赴海外興建的業者課徵「重稅」。這番談話為美國雲端大廠的海外擴張增添變數，川普當場也透露，連幕僚都是頭一次聽他提起這項構想。
川普說：「我們會全力爭取把資料中心留在美國。」談到限制海外建設時，他又說：「我不知道這算不算突發新聞。我連自己的團隊都還沒說過，不過他們現在就在這裡，我這就告訴他們。」他並未說明可能的稅率或實施時程。

對已在海外布局的美國科技業者來說，資料中心蓋在哪裡，關係到能服務哪些客戶。Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)、亞馬遜(AMZN-US)、微軟(MSFT-US)、Meta(META-US)和甲骨文(ORCL-US)都已在美國以外設有資料中心。對雲端服務商而言，就近設點有助於爭取當地客戶，有時也是為了符合當地法規。若川普的構想付諸實施，業者開拓海外市場時，將得把美方限制也納入選址考量。
川普力促業者在美國興建資料中心，但要找到居民支持的地點，也是一道難題。《CNBC》全美經濟調查顯示，64%的登記選民反對在住家方圓10英里(約16公里)內興建AI資料中心，僅13%表示支持。
川普發表上述談話的前一天，才在中國與中國國家主席習近平、俄羅斯總統普丁舉行三方峰會。川普表示，習近平曾就美國在AI領域的表現向他道賀。
paras_en: According to CNBC, U.S. President Donald Trump said at a White House press conference on Friday (the 20th) that he intends to prohibit American companies from building data centers overseas, or to levy a "heavy tax" on firms that do so. The remarks add uncertainty to the overseas expansion plans of major U.S. cloud providers, and Trump disclosed that even his staff were hearing about the idea for the first time.

Trump said, "We will do everything we can to keep data centers in the United States." When discussing restrictions on overseas construction he added, "I don’t know if this is breaking news. I haven’t even told my own team yet, but they’re here right now, so I’m telling them now." He did not specify any possible tax rate or timeline for implementation.

For U.S. tech firms that have already deployed abroad, the location of a data center determines which customers they can serve. Alphabet (GOOGL-US/GOOG-US), Amazon (AMZN-US), Microsoft (MSFT-US), Meta (META-US) and Oracle (ORCL-US) all operate data centers outside the United States. Proximity helps cloud providers win local customers and sometimes is required to meet local regulations. If Trump’s proposal is enacted, companies will have to factor U.S. restrictions into their site‑selection decisions when expanding overseas.

Trump is urging firms to build data centers in the United States, but finding locations with local resident support is a challenge. A CNBC nationwide economic survey shows that 64% of registered voters oppose building AI data centers within a 10‑mile (about 16‑kilometer) radius of their homes, while only 13% are in favor.

The day before Trump made these remarks, he held a trilateral summit in China with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin. Trump said Xi had congratulated him on the United States' performance in the AI field.

items.title: 美中搶AI霸權也有共同底線！川習同意重大軍事行動不能讓AI自主決定
items.title_en: U.S. and China Agree AI Must Not Autonomously Trigger Major Military Actions, Trump and Xi Share Common Ground
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)周五(20日)表示，美國總統川普與中國國家主席習近平已同意，涉及AI的軍事決策必須有人類參與，不得讓AI自主發動重大軍事行動。他同時預期，美國對輝達(NVDA-US)晶片出口的現行政策不會改變，並強調將限制中國企業透過海外資料中心遠端取得先進AI運算資源。
貝森特結束亞洲行返美後接受《CNBC》訪問，將川普與習近平在深圳會面時達成的軍用AI共識，列為此行的重要成果之一。

重大軍事行動須有人類參與 AI競爭不影響安全共識

貝森特在訪談中使用川普政府偏好的「超級智慧(SI)」一詞，強調人類應始終參與相關軍事決策，不能讓這類技術自主決定重大軍事行動。
他表示，美中即使持續爭奪AI領先地位，也不應影響雙方對人類參與及其他安全措施的共識。
「雙方同意，任何重大軍事行動都不能在沒有人類參與的情況下發動，這與競爭無關。」貝森特說。
不過，他也強調，美國AI實驗室必須維持技術領先，並稱這是防範被用於網路攻擊的「危險」中國AI模型的最佳防禦。
貝森特先前曾與中國副總理何立峰會面，推動建立美中AI對話管道，讓雙方能就相關技術威脅相互通報。川普也曾表示，他與習近平討論過AI，兩人都希望對這項技術進行監管。

輝達晶片出口政策料不變 美國收緊遠端存取管道

談到晶片出口，貝森特表示，H200仍是中國在取得許可後，可以購買的最高階輝達AI晶片。他不預期川普政府目前對輝達晶片出口的政策有所改變。
貝森特指出，中國對H200的訂單相當有限，因為中國正努力建立自身的晶片技術體系。他並認為，中國相關技術「可能仍落後多年」。
美國商務部本周一已採取措施，進一步限制中國取得先進AI晶片，包括收緊中國企業透過海外資料中心租用運算資源的管道。相關臨時規則由財政部與白宮國家安全會議主導擬定。
貝森特表示，適當的晶片限制將會到位，遠端存取也將受到限制。
至於黃仁勳相關爭議，貝森特表示，涉及黃仁勳的間諜疑雲並未在川習雙邊會談中被提及。川普先前也表示，未向習近平提起此事。
貝森特上周曾就與黃樂(Alice Huang)有關的Megaspeed International未被列入美國貿易黑名單一事，將矛頭指向商務部。外界也持續檢視商務部長盧特尼克(Howard Lutnick)在阻止先進AI晶片流向中國方面的角色。
但被問及內閣對中國應採取多強硬立場是否存在歧見時，貝森特淡化分歧，強調官員們「都致力遵循川普總統的指示」。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Friday (the 20th) that President Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping have agreed that military decisions involving AI must include human participation and cannot allow AI to autonomously launch major military actions. He also expects the current U.S. policy on exporting Nvidia (NVDA-US) chips to remain unchanged and stressed that China’s firms will be barred from remotely accessing advanced AI computing resources through overseas data centers.
After returning from Asia, Bessent told CNBC that the military AI consensus reached by Trump and Xi during their meeting in Shenzhen was one of the key outcomes of his trip.

Major military actions must involve humans; AI competition does not affect the safety consensus. Bessent used the Trump administration’s preferred term “superintelligence (SI)” in the interview, emphasizing that humans must always be part of related military decisions and that such technology should not be allowed to decide major military actions on its own.
He said that even as the U.S. and China continue to vie for AI leadership, it should not affect the mutual agreement on human involvement and other safety measures.
“Both sides agree that any major military action cannot be launched without human participation; this is unrelated to competition,” Bessent said.
He also stressed that U.S. AI labs must maintain technological leadership, calling it the best defense against “dangerous” Chinese AI models that could be used for cyber attacks.

Bessent previously met with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng to promote an U.S.-China AI dialogue channel so the two sides can exchange information on technology threats. Trump also said he discussed AI with Xi, and both want regulation of the technology.

Regarding chip exports, Bessent said the H200 remains the highest‑end Nvidia AI chip that China can purchase after obtaining a license, and he does not expect the Trump administration to change its current Nvidia export policy.

He noted that China’s orders for the H200 are quite limited because China is working to build its own chip technology ecosystem, and he believes Chinese related technology “may still be years behind.”

The U.S. Commerce Department took action on Monday to further restrict China’s access to advanced AI chips, tightening the channel for Chinese firms to rent computing resources through overseas data centers. The interim rules were drafted by the Treasury and the White House National Security Council.
Bessent said appropriate chip restrictions will be put in place and remote access will also be limited.

On the controversy involving Jensen Huang, Bessent said the espionage allegations surrounding Huang were not raised in the bilateral Trump‑Xi talks. Trump previously also said he did not bring the issue up with Xi.

Last week Bessent blamed the Commerce Department for Megaspeed International, linked to Alice Huang, not being placed on the U.S. trade blacklist. Observers continue to scrutinize Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick’s role in preventing advanced AI chips from flowing to China.

When asked whether there were differing views within the cabinet on how tough a stance toward China should be, Bessent downplayed any split, emphasizing that officials “are all committed to following President Trump’s directives.”

items.title: 美國通膨預期創9個月新低！11月密大消費信心回升 選後展望轉佳
items.title_en: U.S. Inflation Expectations Hit 9-Month Low as November Consumer Confidence Rebounds; Post-Election Outlook Improves
paras: 美國11月消費者信心回升，一年期通膨預期更大降1個百分點，汽油價格下滑與期中選舉後的經濟展望改善，成為主要支撐。密西根大學周五(20日)公布，11月消費者信心指數終值升至51.5，高於10月的48及初值51，但略低於《彭博》調查經濟學家預估的51.6。
這次調查於10月20日至11月16日進行，涵蓋美國期中選舉前後。民主黨贏得國會兩院控制權，並翻轉多州州長席次，消費者對未來政策與經濟環境的看法也隨之調整。

通膨預期明顯降溫 汽油降價減輕家庭壓力

調查顯示，消費者對未來一年的通膨預期，由10月的4.7%降至3.7%，創2月以來最低；未來五至十年的長期通膨預期，也由3.5%降至3.3%。
一年期通膨預期下降，主要反映預估通膨將達5%以上的受訪者明顯減少。其中，無黨派選民的一年期通膨預期降至2月以來最低，民主黨支持者則降至近兩年最低。共和黨支持者的預期略升，但仍低於今年稍早水準。
汽油降價提供部分喘息空間。根據美國汽車協會(AAA)數據，全美平均汽油價格在月初仍高於每加侖4美元，到調查結束時已降至約3.75美元。
密大消費者調查主任Joanne Hsu指出，選後受訪者對汽油價格的預期明顯下降，目前已大致接近伊朗戰事前的水準。
消費者對當前經濟情況與未來展望的評估均改善，個人財務現況指標也升至7月以來最高。低資產家庭改善最明顯，中等資產家庭也有較小幅度的改善；相較之下，股票持有部位最大的受訪者，個人財務評估反而下降，與AI相關股市持續震盪的情況一致。

無黨派選民展望大增 民眾仍最擔心通膨

Hsu表示，消費者似乎預期，未來行政與立法分由不同政黨掌控，可能帶來公共政策調整，因此無黨派選民的預期指數大幅攀升。
民主黨支持者的展望也改善，但幅度較溫和；共和黨支持者則轉弱，可能反映他們不樂見白宮政策議程推進速度放慢。
長期通膨預期的下降，則完全由無黨派選民帶動。民主黨支持者的預期與上月持平，共和黨支持者略升。
儘管信心回暖，美國家庭仍承受高物價與高借貸成本壓力，30年期房貸利率自9月中旬以來一直高於7%。持續漲價曾使消費者信心在5月降至歷史低點，10月則落在歷來次低。
Hsu也提醒，即使通膨預期降溫，消費者仍普遍認為，未來一至兩年，通膨造成的生活困難將大於失業問題。
paras_en: U.S. consumer confidence rose in November, and one-year inflation expectations fell by a full percentage point, driven by lower gasoline prices and an improved economic outlook after the midterm elections. The University of Michigan released on Friday (the 20th) that the final November consumer confidence index rose to 51.5, up from 48 in October and the preliminary 51, but slightly below Bloomberg economists' forecast of 51.6.

The survey was conducted from October 20 to November 16, covering the period before and after the U.S. midterm elections. Democrats won control of both chambers of Congress and flipped several state governorships, prompting consumers to adjust their views on future policy and the economic environment.

Inflation expectations cooled sharply, and lower gasoline prices eased household pressure. The survey showed that consumers’ one‑year inflation expectation fell from 4.7% in October to 3.7%, the lowest since February, while five‑ to ten‑year long‑term inflation expectations dropped from 3.5% to 3.3%.

The decline in one‑year inflation expectations mainly reflects a sharp reduction in respondents who expected inflation to exceed 5%. Among them, independent voters’ one‑year expectations fell to the lowest level since February, and Democratic supporters’ expectations fell to a near‑two‑year low. Republican supporters’ expectations rose slightly but remain below earlier levels this year.

Gasoline price cuts provided some breathing room. According to the American Automobile Association (AAA), the national average gasoline price was still above $4 per gallon at the start of the month, but fell to about $3.75 by the end of the survey period.

University of Michigan consumer survey director Joanne Hsu noted that after the election, respondents’ expectations for gasoline prices dropped markedly and are now roughly back to pre‑Iran‑conflict levels.

Consumers’ assessments of current economic conditions and future outlook both improved, and personal‑finance indicators rose to their highest since July. The improvement was most pronounced for low‑asset households, with moderate‑asset households also seeing modest gains; by contrast, respondents with the largest stock holdings reported a decline in personal‑finance assessments, consistent with continued volatility in AI‑related stocks.

Independent voters’ outlook surged, though the public remains most concerned about inflation. Hsu said consumers appear to expect that future executive and legislative control will be split between parties, potentially prompting policy adjustments, which drove the sharp rise in the independent‑voter index.

Democratic supporters also saw their outlook improve, but to a milder degree; Republican supporters’ outlook weakened, possibly reflecting displeasure with a slower pace of the White House policy agenda.

The drop in long‑term inflation expectations was driven entirely by independent voters. Democratic supporters’ expectations held steady with last month, while Republican supporters’ expectations rose slightly.

Despite the confidence rebound, U.S. households still face pressure from high prices and borrowing costs, with 30‑year mortgage rates staying above 7% since mid‑September. Persistent price hikes pushed consumer confidence down to a historic low in May, with October’s reading ranking among the lowest on record.
Hsu also warned that even as inflation expectations cool, consumers generally believe that inflation‑related hardships over the next one to two years will outweigh concerns about unemployment.

items.title: 輝達距高點跌逾4成！近7個交易日蒸發8110億美元 賣壓還沒完？
items.title_en: Nvidia Falls Over 40% From Its Peak! $811 Billion Market Cap Wiped Out in Seven Trading Days, Is the Selling Pressure Over?
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)股價跌勢延續，即使交出強勁財報，仍難挽回市場信心。據《MarketWatch》報導，輝達周五(20日)盤中下跌約5%，正朝連續第七周收黑邁進，恐創2008年7月以來最長周線連跌紀錄，股價較10月初的歷史收盤高點已回落41.2%。
截至報導時，輝達本周累計下跌13.6%。若跌勢維持至收盤，也將連續第七個交易日下跌，這段期間市值已蒸發8,110億美元，接近摩根大通(JPM-US)約8,470億美元的整家公司市值。
根據道瓊市場數據，輝達市值降至約3.338兆美元，低於Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)的3.385兆美元，退居美國上市公司第四位，也是2024年4月以來首次落後Alphabet。
輝達上一次連續七周下跌，要追溯至2008年7月，當時公司發布獲利預警，並忙於處理部分晶片的瑕疵問題。如今，市場面對的則是領導層更替、董事會調查與AI需求能否持續等多重不確定性。
共同創辦人黃仁勳辭任執行長後，董事會正調查其行為是否危及國家安全或洩露公司機密。不過，輝達在這場風波前就已承壓，投資人持續質疑AI需求成長的可持續性。
公司周二公布強勁財報，並上調明年營收展望，仍未能止住跌勢。Catalyst Funds投資長David Miller表示，股價在強勁財報後依然疲弱，凸顯重建市場信心所需克服的挑戰。
Seaport Research分析師Jay Goldberg指出，部分基金經理人過去因為將輝達視為「安全牌」而持有，如今卻在動盪中轉出持股。
對於後市，Goldberg預期股價下周可能趨於穩定。他表示：「我不認為會一直跌下去。」但他也坦言，在下一任執行長人選明朗前，沒有人急著進場買進。
Miller則認為，輝達仍容易遭遇更多拋售，連跌時間有多長，本身並不能透露股價底部在哪裡。
他表示，股價確實可能強勁反彈，但要對持續復甦更有信心，仍須看到正式領導人選與調查進度更加明朗，以及公司持續落實客戶需求與產品交付。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) shares continued to slide, and even a strong earnings report failed to restore market confidence. MarketWatch reported that on Friday the 20th the stock fell about 5% during the session, heading toward a seventh consecutive week of losses, potentially setting a record for the longest weekly losing streak since July 2008, with the price down 41.2% from its early‑October historical closing high.

By the time of the report Nvidia had fallen a cumulative 13.6% this week. If the decline held through the close, it would mark a seventh straight trading day down, erasing about $811 billion in market value – roughly the entire market cap of JPMorgan (JPM‑US) at about $847 billion.

According to Dow Jones market data Nvidia’s market value slipped to roughly $3.338 trillion, falling below Alphabet (GOOGL‑US/GOOG‑US) at $3.385 trillion and dropping to fourth place among U.S. listed companies, the first time since April 2024 it has lagged Alphabet.

The last time Nvidia logged seven consecutive weeks of decline was back in July 2008, when the company issued a profit warning and was busy addressing defects in some chips. Today the market faces multiple uncertainties, including leadership changes, a board investigation and whether AI demand can be sustained.

Co‑founder Jensen Huang stepped down as CEO and the board is probing whether his actions jeopardized national security or leaked company secrets. Nonetheless Nvidia was already under pressure before the scandal, with investors continuously questioning the sustainability of AI demand growth.

The company posted a strong earnings report on Tuesday and raised its revenue outlook for next year, yet the sell‑off persisted. Catalyst Funds’ CIO David Miller said the stock remained weak after the robust results, highlighting the challenges of rebuilding market confidence.
Seaport Research analyst Jay Goldberg noted that some fund managers who previously held Nvidia as a “safe‑play” are now shedding positions amid the turmoil.

Looking ahead, Goldberg expects the stock may stabilize next week. He said, “I don’t think it will keep falling forever,” but admitted that no one is eager to buy until the next CEO candidate is clear.
Miller, however, believes Nvidia remains vulnerable to further selling and cautioned that the length of the decline does not reveal where the bottom lies.

He added that while a strong rebound is possible, confidence in a sustained recovery will require clearer leadership, progress on the investigation, and continued delivery of customer‑driven products.

items.title: AI股賣壓擴大！道瓊盤中跌入修正 那指今年漲幅全吐光
items.title_en: AI Stock Selling Pressure Expands! Dow Slides into Correction Midday, Nasdaq Erases All Gains This Year
paras: 美股周五(20日)盤中跌勢加劇，科技類股單日跌逾5%，本周累計跌幅擴大至10.5%，恐創2025年4月以來最差單周表現。AI相關類股持續遭到拋售，道瓊指數盤中跌入修正區間，那斯達克指數則吐光今年漲幅、轉為下跌，輝達財報與Anthropic掛牌熱潮均未能穩住市場信心。
截稿前，那斯達克綜合指數下跌3.3%，今年以來累計轉跌0.6%；標普500指數下跌2%；道瓊指數下跌262點、跌幅0.5%，較歷史收盤高點回落逾10%，盤中進入修正區間。
Anthropic(ANT-US)掛牌次日下跌11%，回吐部分周四首日上市17%的漲幅，進一步壓抑AI交易。半導體股跌勢尤其猛烈，超微(AMD-US)重挫11%，輝達(NVDA-US)下跌逾7%，美光(MU-US)更大跌逾12%。
據《CNBC》報導，科技類股賣壓在接近午盤時加劇。截至美東時間上午11時57分，單日跌幅超過5%，本周累跌10.5%，可能創2025年4月4日當周以來最大單周跌幅。當周川普政府宣布大規模進口關稅，引發市場震盪。
這波跌勢延續周四的拋售潮，當時三大指數均下跌逾2%，道瓊更自6月以來首次收在5萬點關卡以下。
本周以來，道瓊累計下跌約6%，可能創2025年4月以來最差單周表現；標普500累跌約7%，那斯達克則下跌約8%，兩者也都朝逾一年來最大單周跌幅邁進。
Procyon美股主管Massimo Santicchia表示，這已不只是估值因素驅動的修正，跌勢正在擴大，目前市場明顯轉向避險。
黃仁勳離任輝達後，投資人對AI產業支出前景與債務融資的擔憂進一步加深。市場同時擔心，AI資本支出成長可能放緩，加上聯準會(Fed)未來可能升息，讓相關投資面臨更高資金成本。《CNBC》形容，在接連的負面消息衝擊下，市場似乎正逼近「投降式拋售」階段。
Catalyst Funds投資長David Miller認為，Anthropic首日強勁表現與科技股普遍下跌同時出現，顯示投資人仍相信AI，但對願意為成長支付的價格更加挑剔。
他指出，輝達領導層的不確定性增添另一層風險，而股價即使在強勁財報後仍持續走弱，也凸顯重建市場信心仍面臨相當大的挑戰。
paras_en: U.S. stocks fell faster on Friday (the 20th) mid‑session, with tech stocks dropping over 5% in a single day; the weekly decline widened to 10.5%, potentially the worst weekly performance since April 2025. AI‑related shares kept getting sold off, the Dow entered correction territory mid‑session, and the Nasdaq gave up all its year‑to‑date gains to turn negative, as Nvidia’s earnings and the Anthropic listing frenzy failed to restore market confidence.

By the time of writing, the Nasdaq Composite was down 3.3% and has slipped 0.6% year‑to‑date; the S&P 500 fell 2%; the Dow dropped 262 points, or 0.5%, more than 10% off its historic closing high and moved into correction range during the session.

Anthropic (ANT‑US) fell 11% the day after its debut, erasing part of the 17% surge it posted on Thursday, further pressuring AI trades. Semiconductor stocks fell especially hard, with AMD plunging 11%, Nvidia sliding over 7%, and Micron tumbling more than 12%.

According to CNBC, tech‑stock selling pressure intensified near the noon session. As of 11:57 a.m. Eastern Time, the single‑day decline exceeded 5% and the week‑to‑date drop hit 10.5%, possibly the biggest weekly fall since the week of April 4 2025, when the Trump administration announced large import tariffs that rattled markets.
The decline continued Thursday’s sell‑off, when all three major indices fell more than 2% and the Dow fell below the 50,000‑point mark for the first time since June.

Since the start of the week, the Dow has slid about 6%, potentially the worst weekly performance since April 2025; the S&P 500 is down roughly 7%, and the Nasdaq about 8%, both edging toward their largest weekly drops in over a year.
Procyon U.S. equities head Massimo Santicchia said the pull‑back is no longer just a valuation‑driven correction; the slide is widening and the market is clearly shifting toward safety.

Since Jensen Huang stepped down from Nvidia, investors have grown more worried about AI‑industry spending outlooks and debt financing. The market also fears AI cap‑ex growth may slow and that the Fed could raise rates, raising funding costs. CNBC described the market as approaching a “surrender‑style sell‑off” amid a string of negative news.

Catalyst Funds chief investment officer David Miller said Anthropic’s strong debut amid a broad tech sell‑off shows investors still believe in AI, but they are becoming pickier about the price they’re willing to pay for growth.

He noted that uncertainty around Nvidia’s leadership adds another layer of risk, and the stock’s continued weakness even after a robust earnings report highlights the considerable challenge of rebuilding market confidence.

items.title: AI風暴燒進債市！CoreWeave違約避險成本飆升 Alphabet創新高
items.title_en: AI Storm Sweeps Into the Bond Market! CoreWeave Default‑Hedge Cost Soars, Alphabet Hits Record High
paras: AI交易震盪的衝擊正從股市蔓延至債市。多家大型雲端與晶片業者的信用風險指標周五(20日)上升，企業債價格同步承壓，其中CoreWeave(CRWV-US)的違約避險成本大幅攀升，市場報價隱含的未來五年違約機率超過65%。
根據ICE Data Services數據，CoreWeave五年期信用違約交換(CDS)一度上升76.2基點，達1,232.6基點。CDS是用來轉移債務違約風險的工具，報價升高代表違約避險成本增加；上述隱含違約機率屬於市場定價推算，並非對實際違約結果的確定預測。
甲骨文(ORCL-US)五年期CDS一度上升4.2基點，至327.9基點，創10月20日以來最高。Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)的同類指標則一度攀升3.8基點，至93.7基點，創歷史新高。
輝達(NVDA-US)、SpaceX(SPCX-US)、Meta(META-US)與博通(AVGO-US)的信用風險指標也同步惡化，顯示AI相關企業面臨的市場壓力，已延伸至債務違約避險交易。
近來科技股遭遇猛烈拋售，全球股市正邁向三年來最長連跌紀錄。市場對AI產業前景、地緣政治及利率走向的疑慮升高，也帶動金融市場波動。
賣壓同時波及美國高收益債與投資等級債的次級市場。根據Trace交易資料，截至紐約時間上午10時35分，CoreWeave票面利率9%、2031年到期的債券，每1美元面額報價下跌約2美分，至80美分左右，相當於面額的八成，位居高收益債市場跌幅最大的債券之列。
paras_en: AI‑driven trading turbulence is spreading from equities to the bond market. Credit‑risk indicators for several large cloud and chip firms rose on Friday (the 20th), putting pressure on corporate bond prices, and CoreWeave’s (CRWV‑US) default‑hedge cost jumped sharply, with market‑quoted implied five‑year default probability exceeding 65%.

According to ICE Data Services, CoreWeave’s five‑year credit default swap (CDS) spiked 76.2 basis points to 1,232.6 basis points. A CDS is a tool for transferring debt‑default risk; a higher quote means higher hedging cost. The implied default probability is derived from market pricing, not a definitive forecast of an actual default.

Oracle’s (ORCL‑US) five‑year CDS briefly rose 4.2 basis points to 327.9 basis points, the highest since October 20. Alphabet (GOOGL‑US/GOOG‑US), Google’s parent, saw its comparable metric climb 3.8 basis points to 93.7 basis points, a historic high.

Nvidia (NVDA‑US), SpaceX (SPCX‑US), Meta (META‑US) and Broadcom (AVGO‑US) also saw their credit‑risk indicators deteriorate, showing that market pressure on AI‑related companies has extended to debt‑default‑hedge trading.

Tech stocks have recently faced heavy selling, and global equity markets are on track for the longest consecutive‑decline streak in three years. Growing doubts about the AI sector’s outlook, geopolitical tensions and interest‑rate trajectories have heightened financial‑market volatility.

Selling pressure has also hit the secondary market for U.S. high‑yield and investment‑grade bonds. Trace trade data show that as of 10:35 a.m. New York time, CoreWeave’s 9% coupon bonds maturing in 2031 were quoted about 2 cents lower per $1 face value, around $0.80, roughly 80% of par, making them among the biggest losers in the high‑yield bond market.

items.title: 輝達被Google母公司超車！退居美股市值第四 股價恐連7周收黑
items.title_en: Nvidia Overtaken by Google’s Parent! Falls to Fourth in US Market Cap, Stock May Close Black for a Seventh Straight Week
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)股價跌勢不止，市值遭Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)超車，退居美國上市公司第四位。據《路透》周五(20日)報導，輝達截至報導時下跌約3%，市值降至3.4兆美元，並可能連續第七周收黑，創2008年以來最長周線連跌紀錄。
這波跌勢發生在輝達公布共同創辦人黃仁勳辭任執行長後的首份財報之際。儘管市場高度關注這次業績，財報仍未能化解投資人對領導層更替，以及AI支出能否持續的疑慮。
輝達市值排名下滑，也反映AI交易內部的投資偏好正在轉變。投資人逐漸偏向除了大舉投入AI，同時已有成熟雲端與軟體營收來源支撐的企業。
根據LSEG數據，Alphabet市值約3.44兆美元，超越輝達、排名第三；微軟(MSFT-US)以3.72兆美元位居第二。
被市場視為對AI交易曝險相對較低的蘋果(AAPL-US)，則以5.08兆美元市值穩居榜首，與其他科技巨頭保持明顯差距。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) shares kept sliding, and its market value was overtaken by Google’s parent company Alphabet (GOOGL-US/GOOG-US), dropping to the fourth‑largest US‑listed company. Reuters reported on Friday (the 20th) that Nvidia was down about 3% at the time of reporting, with its market cap falling to $3.4 trillion, and it could record a seventh consecutive week of losses, the longest weekly losing streak since 2008.

The decline came as Nvidia released its first earnings report after co‑founder Jensen Huang stepped down as CEO. Although the market was closely watching the results, the earnings failed to allay investors’ concerns about the leadership change and whether AI spending can be sustained.

Nvidia’s slip in market‑cap ranking also reflects a shift in AI‑focused investment preferences. Investors are increasingly favoring companies that not only pour heavily into AI but also have mature cloud and software revenue streams to support growth.
According to LSEG data, Alphabet’s market cap is about $3.44 trillion, surpassing Nvidia to rank third, while Microsoft (MSFT-US) sits second with a $3.72 trillion valuation.

Apple (AAPL-US), which the market views as having relatively lower exposure to AI‑related risks, remains at the top with a $5.08 trillion market cap, maintaining a clear lead over the other tech giants.

items.title: 投資心法教學｜輝達財測亮眼，股價為何還跌？用反推估值看市場有多悲觀
items.title_en: Investment Mindset Tutorial: Nvidia's Bright Forecast Yet Stock Falls—Reverse Valuation Shows How Pessimistic the Market Is
paras: 2026年11月20日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 輝達(NVDA-US)第三季營收達1,158億美元，年增103%，下一季營收財測也以1,300億美元高於市場共識。但股價在財報公布後一度上漲，隔天卻收跌。隨後，加州司法部向輝達發出調查傳票，要求公司說明先進晶片或機密資訊是否流向中國，以及對投資人的揭露是否有誤導。財報和財測讓2026年的獲利大致有了底，真正變得難估的是未來幾年。
晨星在加州發出傳票前的財報評論中指出，輝達在尋找新執行長期間，短期營運仍維持成長。公司上季在中國銷售24億美元獲許可的H200產品，下一季財測則未納入直接來自中國客戶的資料中心營收。面對出口限制，輝達預期其他客戶能消化原本供應受限市場的晶片，因此沒有下修成長展望。不過，晨星仍維持「極高不確定性」評估，因為財報表現好，並不代表接班、技術競爭和地緣政治風險已經消失。

不先猜未來，先看股價在假設什麼
一般做折現估值，是先估未來獲利，再換算成今天的價值。反推估值則倒過來，從現在的股價出發。輝達公布最新財測後，2026年的獲利已大致底定，因此可以用2026年的預估獲利作為基期。在給定折現率與第五年之後的長期成長率後，再倒推未來五年的獲利平均每年要成長多少，才能解釋現在的股價。
依這組估值假設，輝達目前的股價約相當於未來五年獲利年均成長2%至3%。這不是對未來的預測，而是一個比較基準：把接班、出口管制和競爭風險都算進去後，你估出的保守成長率，會比股價隱含的2%至3%更高，還是更低？

先把景氣高低拉平，再看有沒有安全邊際
用折線模型反推，有個缺點：它不會告訴你哪一年獲利會下滑、哪一年會回升。同樣是五年年均成長2%至3%，可能是每年小幅成長，也可能是前兩年衰退、後三年回升。實際的盈餘路徑不同，折現後的價值也不會完全一樣。所以這個數字適合用來判斷跨景氣的獲利水準，不適合拿來預測下一季財報或景氣反轉的時間。
更重要的是，今年獲利大致底定，不代表今年的獲利就是常態。如果供不應求把價格和毛利率推到高檔，用這樣的獲利當起點，反推出來的成長率就容易偏低，讓股價看起來比實際更便宜。因此，還要用供需較平衡時能維持的獲利重算一次。如果換成這個基期、把風險算進去之後，保守估值仍高於現價，兩者的差距才是安全邊際。
折現模型不會讓你更確定未來會怎麼走，但能讓你看清楚，就算未來沒有想像中好，今天付的價格還留了多少犯錯空間。

paras_en: November 20, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Nvidia (NVDA-US) posted third‑quarter revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% year‑over‑year, and its outlook for the next quarter projects $130 billion, above market consensus. The stock rose briefly after the earnings release but closed lower the next day. Subsequently, the California Department of Justice issued a subpoena to Nvidia, demanding explanations on whether advanced chips or confidential information have been transferred to China and whether disclosures to investors were misleading. The earnings and guidance set a rough floor for 2026 profits, but estimating the years ahead remains difficult.

Morningstar’s commentary, issued before the California subpoena, noted that while Nvidia searches for a new CEO, short‑term operations continue to grow. Last quarter the company sold $2.4 billion of its approved H200 product in China, but the next‑quarter outlook does not include data‑center revenue directly from Chinese customers. Facing export restrictions, Nvidia expects other customers to absorb chips that can no longer be sold to the restricted market, so it has not lowered its growth outlook. Nevertheless, Morningstar maintains a “very high uncertainty” rating, because strong earnings do not eliminate succession, technology‑competition, and geopolitical risks.

Don’t guess the future first—look at what the stock price assumes. In a traditional discounted‑cash‑flow valuation you forecast future earnings and discount them to today. A reverse valuation works backward, starting from the current price. After Nvidia released its latest guidance, 2026 earnings are roughly set, so they can serve as the base year. Given a discount rate and a long‑term growth rate beyond year five, you can back‑solve how much average annual earnings growth over the next five years is required to justify today’s price.

Using this set of assumptions, Nvidia’s current share price implies an average annual earnings growth of about 2%–3% over the next five years. This is not a forecast but a benchmark: after accounting for succession, export controls and competitive risks, does your conservative growth estimate come out higher or lower than the 2%–3% implied by the market?

Flatten the business cycle first, then assess any margin of safety. The reverse‑DCF line‑chart method has a drawback: it doesn’t tell you which year earnings will dip or rebound. A 2%–3% five‑year average could mean modest growth every year, or a decline in the first two years followed by a recovery in the last three. Different earnings paths yield slightly different discounted values. Thus the figure is useful for gauging profit levels across cycles, not for predicting the next quarter’s results or the timing of a cycle turn.

More importantly, a roughly set 2026 profit does not mean that level is sustainable. If supply‑demand imbalances push prices and margins to the high end, using that profit as a base will produce a reverse‑derived growth rate that is too low, making the stock appear cheaper than it really is. You should recalculate using a profit level that could be maintained when supply and demand are more balanced. If, after adjusting the base and incorporating risks, a conservative valuation still exceeds the current price, the gap represents your margin of safety.
The discounted‑cash‑flow model won’t make the future any more certain, but it clarifies how much error‑room remains in today’s price even if outcomes turn out worse than imagined.

items.title: 光通訊｜明泰投資兆輝電子，布局AI資料中心Micro LED光互連
items.title_en: Optical Communications | Ming Tai Invests in Zhaohui Electronics, Positioning AI Data Center Micro LED Optical Interconnects
paras: 2026年11月20日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 佳世達集團旗下網通廠明泰(3380-TW)11月19日宣布投資光通訊新創兆輝電子，雙方將探索Micro LED光互連技術的共同驗證與系統整合。明泰已推出1.6T高速交換器，這次投資把布局從交換器延伸到設備之間如何以更低耗電傳輸資料。
AI資料中心要在運算設備之間傳送大量資料，除了提高傳輸速度，也要控制傳輸所需的電力。兆輝的做法是把Micro LED當作傳送訊號的光源，讓多個通道同時傳輸，以提高整體頻寬並降低耗電為目標。這裡的Micro LED不是拿來顯示畫面，而是用來傳資料。
雙方分工上，兆輝提供光互連技術，明泰則有網通設備設計與整合能力。明泰目前公布的是探索共同驗證與系統整合的機會，並未表示這項技術已導入既有的1.6T交換器，也未公布量產時程。

paras_en: On November 19, 2026, Ming Tai (3380‑TW), the networking subsidiary of the JASDAQ Group, announced an investment in optical‑communication startup Zhaohui Electronics. The two companies will jointly explore verification and system integration of Micro LED optical interconnect technology. Ming Tai has already launched a 1.6‑terabit high‑speed switch, and this investment extends its focus from switches to how devices can transmit data with lower power consumption.

AI data centers need to move massive amounts of data between compute units. In addition to higher transmission speeds, power consumption must be controlled. Zhaohui’s approach uses Micro LEDs as light sources for signal transmission, enabling multiple channels to operate simultaneously to boost overall bandwidth while reducing energy use. Here, the Micro LEDs are not for display but for data transfer.

In the partnership, Zhaohui will provide the optical interconnect technology, while Ming Tai contributes its networking equipment design and integration expertise. Ming Tai has only announced the opportunity to explore joint verification and system integration; it has not said the technology is already incorporated into its existing 1.6‑terabit switch, nor has it disclosed a mass‑production timeline.

items.title: 〈晶呈法說〉晶呈展2項光纖專利新技術布局市場 不受AI需求疑放緩減少擴產
items.title_en: Jingcheng Earnings Call: Jingcheng Deploys Two New Fiber Optic Patent Technologies to Market, Unaffected by AI Demand Slowdown Concerns, Expands Production
paras: 特殊氣體廠晶呈科技(4768-TW)今(20)日舉行法說會，針對全球AI市場波動，有法人指出，全球AI有減緩需求的發展疑慮。晶呈科技董事長陳亞理今在法說上表示，目前AI客戶需求未變，公司正積極擴大TGV(玻璃通孔)擴產計畫也如期推進，明(2027)年底前將累計完成建置12條產線。
晶呈也在法說上展現2項光纖自動化組裝相關專利技術，並透過技術整合加快CPO(共同封裝光學)相關產品的商業化進程。
晶呈表示，從目前接收到AI領域客戶訊息顯示，需求面上產品及出貨數量仍維持穩定，素前TGV Glass Core主要客戶集中於通訊ASIC下的IC設計公司及CPO FAU領域。
晶呈指出，這2個區塊為主要市場，目前TGV成長幅度正逐步擴大，且晶呈TGV Glass Core Board是以既有氣態分解熔蝕技術發展的工藝，因此亦可用於非玻璃材料，公司對於未來前景展望非常樂觀。
此外，晶呈也在法說上展示，近期釋出的2項光纖自動化組裝相關專利技術，包括光纖自動穿入系統及內嵌式磁性導引光纖技術，將透過磁力牽引取代傳統機械推入方式，以提升FAU光纖組裝效率與良率。
晶呈表示，目前已與光纖製造商及設備開發商接洽合作，希望透過技術整合加快 CPO 相關產品的商業化進程，目前這項2項專利，自本(11)月起正式對外界推廣，初期市場反應非常不錯，公司正與潛在客戶洽談相關授權。
據晶呈提供資訊，目前晶呈的專利布局，截至今(2026)年10月31日為止，已取得103件、申請中49件(皆為發明專利)，其中TGV已取得9件、仍在申請中有18件。
paras_en: Specialty gas maker Jingcheng Technology (4768-TW) held its earnings conference today (20th). Regarding fluctuations in the global AI market, some institutional investors noted concerns that AI demand may be slowing. Chairman Chen Yali said at the conference that AI customer demand remains unchanged, and the company is actively expanding its TGV (through‑glass via) production plan, which is proceeding on schedule and aims to complete the construction of 12 production lines by the end of 2027.

Jingcheng also showcased two fiber‑optic automation assembly patent technologies during the conference and said it will accelerate the commercialization of CPO (co‑packaged optics) related products through technology integration.

Jingcheng indicated that messages received from AI‑sector customers show that product demand and shipment volumes remain stable. Its primary TGV Glass Core customers are IC design firms in the communications ASIC space and the CPO FAU (fiber‑array unit) field.

Jingcheng pointed out that these two segments constitute its main market. The TGV growth rate is gradually expanding, and the TGV Glass Core Board is developed using its existing gas‑phase etching technology, which can also be applied to non‑glass materials. The company is very optimistic about future prospects.

In addition, Jingcheng demonstrated two recently released fiber‑optic automation assembly patents, including an automatic fiber insertion system and an embedded magnetic‑guided fiber technology. The magnetic pull will replace traditional mechanical pushing to improve FAU fiber assembly efficiency and yield.

Jingcheng said it has already engaged fiber manufacturers and equipment developers to cooperate, aiming to speed up the commercialization of CPO products through technology integration. The two patents have been publicly promoted since this November, and early market response has been very positive; the company is negotiating licensing with potential customers.

According to information provided by Jingcheng, as of October 31, 2026, the company holds 103 granted patents and has 49 patent applications pending (all inventions). Among them, 9 TGV patents have been granted and 18 are pending.

items.title: 集保發布ESG評級與數據產品提供者行為準則 開放國內外機構簽署
items.title_en: CSDC Releases ESG Rating and Data Provider Code of Conduct, Opens Signing to Domestic and International Institutions
paras: 為提升台灣永續評級市場透明度與公信力，並與國際標準接軌，集保結算所近日於「台灣週—永續金融新篇章國際論壇」正式發布「ESG評級與數據產品提供者行為準則」，並於投資人關係整合平台（ESG IR平台）設置準則專區，開放國內外ESG評級及數據產品提供者自願簽署遵循。
集保結算所表示，有意簽署的機構可至ESG IR平台準則專區參閱相關資訊，並提交遵循聲明書完成簽署。簽署後，ESG評級機構須於6個月導入期內，數據產品提供者則須於12個月導入期內，自提交遵循聲明書之日起算，依準則附件格式向集保結算所提交自我評核文件，後續並須至少每年檢視一次，必要時更新。
此外，為引導機構投資人採用具公信力的永續評級資訊，116年「盡職治理資訊揭露較佳名單評比標準」也新增相關規範，要求機構投資人優先考量已簽署遵循行為準則的ESG評級機構，進一步提升永續評級資訊的透明度與合規性。
集保結算所指出，隨著市場對ESG評級透明度及合規性的重視日益提升，邀請國內外ESG評級與數據產品提供者踴躍簽署並落實自我評核，共同建立具公信力及國際互通性的台灣永續金融環境。
paras_en: To enhance the transparency and credibility of Taiwan's sustainable rating market and align it with international standards, the Central Securities Depository (CSDC) recently unveiled the "ESG Rating and Data Product Provider Code of Conduct" at the "Taiwan Week – New Chapter of Sustainable Finance International Forum." The code has been placed in a dedicated section on the Investor Relations Integration Platform (ESG IR Platform), allowing ESG rating agencies and data providers from both domestic and overseas to voluntarily sign and adhere to it.

CSDC states that institutions wishing to sign may visit the code section on the ESG IR Platform to review the relevant information and submit a compliance declaration to complete the signing. After signing, ESG rating agencies must implement the code within a six‑month transition period, while data product providers have a twelve‑month transition period. Starting from the submission date of the compliance declaration, they must submit self‑assessment documents to CSDC in the format attached to the code, and thereafter conduct at least an annual review and update as needed.

In addition, to guide institutional investors toward using credible sustainable rating information, the 2027 "Better Governance Information Disclosure Ranking Standards" have added related provisions, requiring institutional investors to give priority to ESG rating agencies that have signed the code of conduct, thereby further improving the transparency and compliance of sustainable rating information.

CSDC notes that as market attention to ESG rating transparency and compliance grows, it invites ESG rating agencies and data product providers worldwide to actively sign and carry out self‑assessments, jointly building a credible and internationally interoperable sustainable finance environment in Taiwan.

items.title: AI訂單大增也更吃資金！央行：伺服器備料到收款時間長，台廠周轉需求提高
items.title_en: AI Orders Surge and Also Consume More Capital! Central Bank: Server Material Preparation to Collection Takes Long, Taiwanese Manufacturers' Working‑Capital Needs Rise
paras: 2026年11月20日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 央行公布第三季國際收支時指出，台廠因應擴產及資本支出增加，今年前三季新增國內銀行外幣借款超過162億美元，並發行116億美元海外可轉債及77億美元海外存託憑證(GDR)。企業保留美元收入，主要是為了營運及自然避險，並非外界所指的出口商惜售外匯。
除了擴產投資，AI伺服器訂單成長也提高台廠的資金調度需求。央行表示，新一代伺服器的高單價零組件需要先墊款，從備料到產品驗收、收款的時間較長，廠商必須準備足夠資金支應營運。
從接單情況來看，經濟部公布的10月外銷訂單達1,238.2億美元，年增78.3%，增幅創紀錄，高於市場預期的64.3%，也比9月的62.4%加快。外銷訂單已連續21個月年增，近三個月每月接單都超過1,000億美元。
經濟部指出，AI、高效能運算及雲端服務需求強勁，帶動資訊通信產品接單年增107.2%，電子產品接單也成長89.8%。對供應鏈而言，訂單增加雖然帶來營收成長機會，但廠商必須先採購零組件、投入生產，待產品交付驗收後才能收款。隨著備料規模擴大，需要周轉的資金也可能增加。
緯穎(6669-TW)的財報可作為觀察案例。公司第三季底存貨達3,084億元，較第二季底增加49%；應收帳款增至1,144億元，增加36%。同期應付帳款也增至2,414億元，季增55%，顯示部分採購款尚未支付，抵銷部分備料與應收款增加的資金需求。
緯穎前三季稅後淨利524億元，營業活動現金流量卻淨流出568億元，高於去年同期流出的130億元。若拆開來看，上半年淨流出616億元，第三季單季則淨流入約47億元，顯示資金流向會隨備料、付款與收款時點變動。
除了自有產品備料，廠商代客戶採購也可能增加資金調度需求。緯穎表示，從4月起，部分客戶的記憶體採購改採代購模式，相關金額不列入營收及銷貨成本。公司第三季底其他應收款達1,103億元，財報說明主要與代第三方及關係人採購原物料、提供人力支援等業務有關。
緯穎也著手籌措資金。公司11月董事會通過發行海外存託憑證(GDR)計畫，以不超過1,800萬股普通股參與發行，目的為充實營運資金，目前尚未完成募資。
廣達(2382-TW)前三季的情況則顯示，供應商付款時點也會影響實際現金流。財報中，應收帳款增加占用約4,370億元，存貨增加占用約3,431億元；同期應付帳款增加提供約7,297億元，加上其他營運項目變動，前三季營業活動現金流仍淨流入680億元。

paras_en: On November 20, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – The central bank, in releasing the third‑quarter international balance of payments, noted that Taiwanese manufacturers, responding to capacity expansion and increased capital expenditures, added more than US$16.2 billion in foreign‑currency loans from domestic banks in the first three quarters of the year, and issued US$11.6 billion of overseas convertible bonds and US$7.7 billion of overseas depositary receipts (GDRs). Companies retain US‑dollar earnings mainly for operating needs and natural hedging, not because exporters are reluctant to sell foreign exchange as some have suggested.

In addition to expansion investment, the growth of AI server orders has heightened manufacturers’ funding‑allocation needs. The central bank said that high‑priced components for next‑generation servers must be prepaid, and the period from material preparation to product acceptance and payment is relatively long, requiring firms to hold sufficient cash to support operations.

Looking at order intake, the Ministry of Economic Affairs reported that October’s export orders reached US$123.82 billion, up 78.3% year‑on‑year – a record increase, exceeding market expectations of 64.3% and accelerating from September’s 62.4%. Export orders have posted year‑on‑year growth for 21 consecutive months, and for the past three months each month’s orders have surpassed US$100 billion.

The Ministry added that strong demand for AI, high‑performance computing and cloud services drove a 107.2% year‑on‑year rise in information‑communication product orders and an 89.8% rise in electronic product orders. For the supply chain, while the order surge creates revenue opportunities, manufacturers must first purchase components and commence production, and can only collect payment after product delivery and acceptance. As material‑stocking scales up, the required working capital may also increase.

Wiwynn (6669‑TW) provides a case in point. Its third‑quarter ending inventory reached NT$308.4 billion, 49% higher than the end of the second quarter; accounts receivable rose to NT$114.4 billion, up 36%. At the same time, accounts payable grew to NT$241.4 billion, a 55% quarterly increase, indicating that some procurement payments remain unpaid, offsetting part of the cash demand from larger inventories and receivables.

Wiwynn’s after‑tax net profit for the first three quarters was NT$52.4 billion, yet cash flow from operating activities showed a net outflow of NT$56.8 billion, higher than the NT$13 billion outflow in the same period last year. Broken down, the first half of the year saw a net outflow of NT$61.6 billion, while the third quarter alone recorded a net inflow of about NT$4.7 billion, showing that cash movement varies with the timing of material stocking, payments and collections.

Beyond its own product stocking, manufacturers’ procurement on behalf of customers can also raise funding needs. Wiwynn said that starting in April, some customers switched their memory purchases to a procurement‑on‑behalf model, with the related amounts excluded from revenue and cost of goods sold. At the end of the third quarter, other receivables reached NT$110.3 billion, primarily linked to third‑party and related‑party raw‑material purchases and manpower support services.

Wiwynn is also seeking additional financing. In November, its board approved a plan to issue overseas depositary receipts (GDRs) involving up to 18 million ordinary shares, aimed at bolstering operating capital; the fundraising has not yet been completed.

Quanta Computer (2382‑TW) shows that the timing of supplier payments also affects actual cash flow. Its financial statements indicate that accounts receivable increased by about NT$437 billion, inventory rose by about NT$343 billion, while accounts payable grew by roughly NT$729 billion. Combined with changes in other operating items, operating cash flow for the first three quarters remained a net inflow of NT$68 billion.

items.title: 研揚推BOX PC新品搶攻實體AI商機 布局人形機器人新市場
items.title_en: Renyang Launches New BOX PC to Capture Physical AI Opportunities, Targeting Humanoid Robot Market
paras: 工業電腦廠研揚(6579-TW)推出首款搭載NVIDIA Jetson Thor平台的嵌入式Box PC BOXER-8741AI，採用NVIDIA Jetson T5000模組，具備最高2070 FP4 TFLOPS AI運算效能，並配置多元高速網路及機器人專用I/O介面，鎖定工業級人形機器人、自主移動機器人(AMR)及服務型機器人等應用。

研揚指出，BOXER-8741AI搭載NVIDIA Jetson T5000模組，內建14核心Arm Neoverse-V3AE CPU及128GB LPDDR5X記憶體，並整合採用NVIDIA Blackwell架構的2560核心GPU，以及第五代Tensor Cores，提供最高2070 FP4 TFLOPS的AI運算效能。相較NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin，AI運算效能最高提升7.5倍，能源效率也提升3.5倍，可支援高運算需求的邊緣AI應用。
在I/O介面配置方面，BOXER-8741AI配備2組10GbE及4組5GbE RJ-45網路連接埠，可連接多組高頻寬感測設備；另針對人形機器人的分散式致動器通訊、感測器連接及即時監控需求，提供3組DB-9連接埠，支援雙通道CAN FD、RS-232、RS-485及8-bit GPIO介面。
此外，系統也配備4組USB 3.2 Gen 2連接埠，以及M.2 M-Key、B-Key及E-Key擴充插槽，可安裝NVMe儲存裝置、4G/5G/LTE及Wi-Fi/BT無線通訊模組，並內建Nano SIM卡插槽，提供開發者彈性的系統擴充選擇。
在環境耐受性方面，BOXER-8741AI機身尺寸為240mm × 164.8mm × 105.1mm，支援-20°C至60°C寬溫操作，並透過2-pin端子台連接器提供19V至48V寬範圍電源輸入，同時具備抗震及耐衝擊能力，可部署於工業機器人等動態及高震動環境。

軟體方面，BOXER-8741AI支援NVIDIA JetPack 7及後續版本，並可運行NVIDIA針對實體AI(Physical AI)應用打造的軟體堆疊，包括機器人開發平台NVIDIA Isaac、支援視覺代理式AI(Visual Agentic AI)的NVIDIA Metropolis，以及專為感測器資料處理設計的NVIDIA Holoscan，協助開發者加速建構新一代智慧機器人及邊緣AI解決方案。
paras_en: Industrial computer maker Renyang (6579‑TW) has introduced its first embedded Box PC, the BOXER‑8741AI, built on NVIDIA’s Jetson Thor platform and featuring an NVIDIA Jetson T5000 module. It delivers up to 2070 FP4 TFLOPS of AI compute power, includes multiple high‑speed networking options and robot‑specific I/O, and is aimed at industrial‑grade humanoid robots, autonomous mobile robots (AMR) and service robots.

Renyang notes that the BOXER‑8741AI’s Jetson T5000 module houses a 14‑core Arm Neoverse‑V3AE CPU and 128 GB of LPDDR5X memory, and integrates a 2560‑core GPU based on NVIDIA’s Blackwell architecture with fifth‑generation Tensor Cores, providing a peak AI performance of 2070 FP4 TFLOPS. Compared with the NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, AI performance is up to 7.5 times higher and energy efficiency 3.5 times better, supporting demanding edge‑AI workloads.

For I/O, the BOXER‑8741AI offers two 10 GbE and four 5 GbE RJ‑45 ports for connecting multiple high‑bandwidth sensors. It also adds three DB‑9 connectors to meet the distributed actuator communication, sensor linking and real‑time monitoring needs of humanoid robots, supporting dual‑channel CAN FD, RS‑232, RS‑485 and 8‑bit GPIO interfaces.

The system further includes four USB 3.2 Gen 2 ports and M.2 M‑Key, B‑Key and E‑Key slots, allowing installation of NVMe storage, 4G/5G/LTE and Wi‑Fi/BT wireless modules, and it has a built‑in nano‑SIM slot, giving developers flexible expansion options.

In terms of environmental robustness, the BOXER‑8741AI measures 240 mm × 164.8 mm × 105.1 mm, operates from –20 °C to 60 °C, and accepts a wide‑range power input of 19 V to 48 V via a 2‑pin terminal block. It also features shock and impact resistance, making it suitable for deployment in dynamic, high‑vibration settings such as industrial robots.

On the software side, the BOXER‑8741AI supports NVIDIA JetPack 7 and future releases, and can run NVIDIA’s software stack for Physical AI applications, including the robot development platform NVIDIA Isaac, the visual‑agentic AI suite NVIDIA Metropolis, and the sensor‑data processing framework NVIDIA Holoscan, helping developers accelerate the creation of next‑generation smart robots and edge‑AI solutions.
