items.title: 觀光研訓院與日本交通公社簽MOU 台日觀光從市場互訪邁向政策研究
items.title_en: TTI and Japan Travel Bureau Sign MOU, Taiwan-Japan Tourism Moves from Market Exchanges to Policy Research
paras: 台灣觀光研訓院(TTI)與日本交通公社(JTB)於今(20)日在圓山大飯店舉行合作備忘錄(MOU)簽署儀式，由觀光研訓院董事長暨老爺酒店集團執行長沈方正與日本交通公社會長小林高広會長代表簽署。觀光研訓院表示，此次簽署象徵台日觀光從「市場互訪」邁向「智庫交流」與前瞻政策研究的新里程碑。
觀光署長陳玉秀致詞時表示，面對全球旅遊市場快速轉型，台灣觀光正處於從「追求人數成長」轉向「創造高附加價值」的關鍵時刻，更重視旅客停留時間、深度文化體驗，為落實《2030臺灣觀光政策白皮書》及「觀光主流化」願景。
日台交流協會台北事務所副代表川合現表示，日台皆將「觀光立國」列為重要政策目標，期盼透過兩大觀光智庫的知識共享與共同研究，創造「旅客、產業、在地」三方共好的永續發展新價值。

小林高広表示，日本交通公社自1912年成立以來，長期深耕旅遊市場調查、旅客行為分析及目的地經營等領域研究；面對全球觀光環境的快速變遷，跨國智庫間的深度對話與經驗交流更顯得不可或缺，此次與台灣觀光研訓院（TTI）簽署合作備忘錄，是深化國際交流的重要一步，未來雙方將以「共同成長、拓展研究領域、深化資料合作及定期交流」為四大合作方向，透過研究人員交流、觀光課題共同探討及研究數據共享，結合雙方專業與研究優勢，建立長期合作機制，共同推動觀光研究創新與區域觀光發展。
沈方正則表示，他從事觀光旅宿產業40多年，深感觀光的本質最終要回歸「人」；而產業能走多遠，除了仰賴第一線業者的經驗，更需要有系統地整理經驗與研究趨勢，讓研究成果不只停留在報告中，而能真正回應產業現場的需求。
沈方正強調，此次與日方建立合作關係，並非尋找一套可直接複製的模式，而是期盼透過雙向交流，讓不同的研究觀點和實務經驗相互激盪，進而為產業提供更厚實的知識與人才動能，也為觀光永續發展帶來更長遠的視野，透過此次簽署，未來將針對觀光預測、觀光資源與環境管理、觀光行銷推廣、觀光政策規劃及科技應用等議題，深化資訊與經驗共享；同時將研議研究課題、辦理學術研討活動及推動研究人員互訪，逐步建立長期研究合作機制。
paras_en: Taiwan Tourism Training Institute (TTI) and Japan Travel Bureau (JTB) held a memorandum of understanding (MOU) signing ceremony today (the 20th) at the Grand Hotel in Yuanshan. The ceremony was signed by TTI Chairman and CEO of the Lao Ye Hotel Group, Shen Fangzheng, and JTB President Kobayashi Takahiro. TTI said the signing marks a new milestone as Taiwan-Japan tourism shifts from “market visits” to “think‑tank exchanges” and forward‑looking policy research.

During his remarks, Tourism Bureau Director Chen Yuxiu said that faced with the rapid transformation of the global travel market, Taiwan’s tourism is at a pivotal moment of moving from “pursuing visitor numbers” to “creating high‑value‑added experiences.” The focus is now on longer stays and deeper cultural experiences to implement the “2030 Taiwan Tourism Policy White Paper” and the vision of “mainstream tourism.”

Kawahara, deputy representative of the Japan‑Taiwan Exchange Association’s Taipei office, said both Japan and Taiwan regard “tourism as a nation‑building strategy” as a key policy goal. He hopes that knowledge sharing and joint research between the two major tourism think tanks will create new sustainable‑development value that benefits travelers, the industry, and local communities alike.

JTB President Kobayashi Takahiro noted that since its founding in 1912, JTB has long been involved in tourism market research, traveler behavior analysis, and destination management studies. In the face of rapid changes in the global tourism environment, deep dialogue and experience exchange between cross‑border think tanks are indispensable. Signing the MOU with TTI is an important step to deepen international exchange. The two sides will focus on four cooperation areas: joint growth, expanding research fields, deepening data collaboration, and regular exchanges. Through researcher exchanges, joint tourism‑topic studies, and shared data, they will combine their expertise to build a long‑term cooperation mechanism that drives tourism research innovation and regional tourism development.

Shen Fangzheng, who has worked in the tourism and hospitality industry for over 40 years, said the essence of tourism ultimately returns to “people.” The industry's progress depends not only on frontline operators’ experience but also on systematically organizing that experience and research trends so that findings go beyond reports and truly meet industry needs.

Shen emphasized that the partnership with the Japanese side is not about finding a directly copyable model, but about fostering two‑way exchange so that different research perspectives and practical experiences can spark each other. This will provide the industry with richer knowledge and talent resources and give tourism sustainable development a longer‑term outlook. Through the signing, future collaboration will deepen information and experience sharing on tourism forecasting, resource and environmental management, marketing, policy planning, and technology applications, as well as develop research topics, hold academic seminars, and promote researcher visits, gradually establishing a long‑term research cooperation mechanism.

items.title: SpaceX旗下Cursor也用中國AI！為何如今考慮逐步停用？
items.title_en: SpaceX's Cursor Also Uses Chinese AI! Why Is It Now Considering Phasing It Out?
paras: 據《CNBC》周五(20日)報導，SpaceX(SPCX-US)旗下AI程式開發平台Cursor已向美國國會議員表示，正因「地緣政治風險」，考慮逐步停用中國開發的開放權重AI模型。Cursor先前以中國AI公司月之暗面(Moonshot AI)的Kimi K2.5為基礎，打造自家程式模型Composer 2，如今相關技術選擇成為美國國會關注焦點。
這項訊息來自美國眾議院國土安全委員會與中國問題特別委員會共同製作的報告。《CNBC》在報告預定周五公布前，獨家取得相關內容。

Cursor採用Kimi打造模型 向國會透露調整計畫

報告指出，Cursor已告知兩個委員會，將研議因應地緣政治風險，逐步停用中國開發的開放權重模型。目前這項調整仍處於研究階段，並未宣布全面停用或提出明確時程。
SpaceX今年6月宣布簽署收購Cursor的正式協議，並於8月完成交易，當時Cursor的隱含股權估值達600億美元。除了提供AI程式開發工具，Cursor也參與SpaceX旗下Grok系列模型的訓練。
這份報告歷經數月調查，檢視中國AI模型如何被納入美國企業的技術系統。除了Cursor，Airbnb(ABNB-US)與DoorDash(DASH-US)也就使用中國AI模型的情況，配合國會調查提供說明。
中國模型今年在全球的使用量快速增加。隨著模型能力提升，美中AI競爭也進一步延伸至企業採用、技術依賴與國家安全等層面。

低成本推動中國模型普及 國會建議擴大聯邦限制

報告認為，成本、客製化能力，以及接近頂尖模型的效能，是中國AI模型受到企業青睞的主要原因。相較之下，美國缺乏能在市場要求的價格與效能之間，提供競爭力的開放權重替代方案。
報告並警告，北京正試圖將這些技術進展轉化為全球市占率，以及使用者對中國模型的長期依賴。
為此，報告建議推動「美國國家級開放權重計畫」，整合公共運算資源、共用評測基礎設施，以及合法取得美國頂尖模型供訓練使用的管道。
報告也主張，在10月公開、禁止聯邦文職機關系統使用DeepSeek的命令基礎上，進一步禁止聯邦資訊系統，以及執行聯邦合約時使用中國開發的AI模型。
此外，華府也關注中國企業透過海外資料中心，遠端使用輝達(NVDA-US)晶片，以及利用「蒸餾」技術，藉既有模型協助訓練新模型的情況。美國商務部工業與安全局(BIS)已於本周一公布一項臨時最終規則，旨在阻止中國企業遠端取得AI晶片運算資源。
針對《CNBC》的置評要求，Cursor、SpaceX與DoorDash未回應，Airbnb拒絕評論；BIS、中國外交部及中國駐英國大使館也未提供回應。
paras_en: According to CNBC on Friday (the 20th), SpaceX's (SPCX-US) AI programming platform Cursor has told U.S. lawmakers that, due to "geopolitical risk," it is considering gradually discontinuing the use of open-weight AI models developed in China. Cursor previously built its own programming model Composer 2 based on Moonshot AI's Kimi K2.5, and this technology choice has now become a focus of congressional attention.

The information comes from a report jointly produced by the House Homeland Security Committee and the Special Committee on China. CNBC obtained the relevant content exclusively before the report’s scheduled Friday release.

The report notes that Cursor has informed the two committees that it will study how to respond to geopolitical risk by gradually phasing out Chinese-developed open-weight models. The adjustment is still in the research stage, with no announcement of a full shutdown or a clear timeline.

SpaceX announced in June that it had signed a definitive agreement to acquire Cursor, completing the transaction in August, at which time Cursor’s implied equity valuation was $60 billion. In addition to providing AI programming tools, Cursor also participates in training SpaceX’s Grok series models.

The report, compiled over several months, examined how Chinese AI models are being incorporated into U.S. companies’ technology stacks. Besides Cursor, Airbnb (ABNB-US) and DoorDash (DASH-US) also provided explanations to congressional investigators regarding their use of Chinese AI models.

Chinese models have seen a rapid increase in global usage this year. As model capabilities improve, the U.S.-China AI competition is extending into corporate adoption, technological dependence, and national security dimensions.

The report attributes the popularity of Chinese AI models among enterprises to low cost, customization ability, and performance close to top-tier models. By contrast, the U.S. lacks open-weight alternatives that can competitively balance price and performance in the market.
The report warns that Beijing is trying to turn these technological advances into global market share and to create long-term user dependence on Chinese models.

To address this, the report recommends launching a "U.S. National Open-Weight Initiative" that would integrate public computing resources, shared benchmarking infrastructure, and lawful channels to obtain top U.S. models for training use.

The report also advocates that, building on the October order prohibiting federal civilian agency systems from using DeepSeek, further bans be placed on federal information systems and on the use of Chinese-developed AI models in the performance of federal contracts.

Additionally, Washington is concerned about Chinese firms using overseas data centers to remotely access NVIDIA (NVDA-US) chips and employing "distillation" techniques to leverage existing models to train new ones. The Department of Commerce’s Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) announced a temporary final rule on Monday aimed at preventing Chinese companies from remotely obtaining AI chip computing resources.

When asked for comment by CNBC, Cursor, SpaceX and DoorDash did not respond, Airbnb declined to comment, and BIS, China’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and the Chinese embassy in the United Kingdom also provided no response.

items.title: 川普想把資料中心留在美國！美企赴海外興建恐遭禁或被課重稅
items.title_en: Trump Wants to Keep Data Centers in the U.S.! U.S. Companies Building Abroad May Face Ban or Heavy Tax
paras: 據《CNBC》報導，美國總統川普周五(20日)在白宮記者會上表示，他打算禁止美國企業在海外興建資料中心，或對赴海外興建的業者課徵「重稅」。這番談話為美國雲端大廠的海外擴張增添變數，川普當場也透露，連幕僚都是頭一次聽他提起這項構想。
川普說：「我們會全力爭取把資料中心留在美國。」談到限制海外建設時，他又說：「我不知道這算不算突發新聞。我連自己的團隊都還沒說過，不過他們現在就在這裡，我這就告訴他們。」他並未說明可能的稅率或實施時程。

對已在海外布局的美國科技業者來說，資料中心蓋在哪裡，關係到能服務哪些客戶。Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)、亞馬遜(AMZN-US)、微軟(MSFT-US)、Meta(META-US)和甲骨文(ORCL-US)都已在美國以外設有資料中心。對雲端服務商而言，就近設點有助於爭取當地客戶，有時也是為了符合當地法規。若川普的構想付諸實施，業者開拓海外市場時，將得把美方限制也納入選址考量。
川普力促業者在美國興建資料中心，但要找到居民支持的地點，也是一道難題。《CNBC》全美經濟調查顯示，64%的登記選民反對在住家方圓10英里(約16公里)內興建AI資料中心，僅13%表示支持。
川普發表上述談話的前一天，才在中國與中國國家主席習近平、俄羅斯總統普丁舉行三方峰會。川普表示，習近平曾就美國在AI領域的表現向他道賀。
paras_en: According to CNBC, U.S. President Donald Trump said at a White House press conference on Friday (the 20th) that he intends to prohibit American companies from building data centers overseas, or to levy a "heavy tax" on firms that do so. The remarks add uncertainty to the overseas expansion plans of major U.S. cloud providers, and Trump disclosed that even his staff were hearing about the idea for the first time.

Trump said, "We will do everything we can to keep data centers in the United States." When discussing restrictions on overseas construction he added, "I don’t know if this is breaking news. I haven’t even told my own team yet, but they’re here right now, so I’m telling them now." He did not specify any possible tax rate or timeline for implementation.

For U.S. tech firms that have already deployed abroad, the location of a data center determines which customers they can serve. Alphabet (GOOGL-US/GOOG-US), Amazon (AMZN-US), Microsoft (MSFT-US), Meta (META-US) and Oracle (ORCL-US) all operate data centers outside the United States. Proximity helps cloud providers win local customers and sometimes is required to meet local regulations. If Trump’s proposal is enacted, companies will have to factor U.S. restrictions into their site‑selection decisions when expanding overseas.

Trump is urging firms to build data centers in the United States, but finding locations with local resident support is a challenge. A CNBC nationwide economic survey shows that 64% of registered voters oppose building AI data centers within a 10‑mile (about 16‑kilometer) radius of their homes, while only 13% are in favor.

The day before Trump made these remarks, he held a trilateral summit in China with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin. Trump said Xi had congratulated him on the United States' performance in the AI field.

items.title: 美國通膨預期創9個月新低！11月密大消費信心回升 選後展望轉佳
items.title_en: U.S. Inflation Expectations Hit 9-Month Low as November Consumer Confidence Rebounds; Post-Election Outlook Improves
paras: 美國11月消費者信心回升，一年期通膨預期更大降1個百分點，汽油價格下滑與期中選舉後的經濟展望改善，成為主要支撐。密西根大學周五(20日)公布，11月消費者信心指數終值升至51.5，高於10月的48及初值51，但略低於《彭博》調查經濟學家預估的51.6。
這次調查於10月20日至11月16日進行，涵蓋美國期中選舉前後。民主黨贏得國會兩院控制權，並翻轉多州州長席次，消費者對未來政策與經濟環境的看法也隨之調整。

通膨預期明顯降溫 汽油降價減輕家庭壓力

調查顯示，消費者對未來一年的通膨預期，由10月的4.7%降至3.7%，創2月以來最低；未來五至十年的長期通膨預期，也由3.5%降至3.3%。
一年期通膨預期下降，主要反映預估通膨將達5%以上的受訪者明顯減少。其中，無黨派選民的一年期通膨預期降至2月以來最低，民主黨支持者則降至近兩年最低。共和黨支持者的預期略升，但仍低於今年稍早水準。
汽油降價提供部分喘息空間。根據美國汽車協會(AAA)數據，全美平均汽油價格在月初仍高於每加侖4美元，到調查結束時已降至約3.75美元。
密大消費者調查主任Joanne Hsu指出，選後受訪者對汽油價格的預期明顯下降，目前已大致接近伊朗戰事前的水準。
消費者對當前經濟情況與未來展望的評估均改善，個人財務現況指標也升至7月以來最高。低資產家庭改善最明顯，中等資產家庭也有較小幅度的改善；相較之下，股票持有部位最大的受訪者，個人財務評估反而下降，與AI相關股市持續震盪的情況一致。

無黨派選民展望大增 民眾仍最擔心通膨

Hsu表示，消費者似乎預期，未來行政與立法分由不同政黨掌控，可能帶來公共政策調整，因此無黨派選民的預期指數大幅攀升。
民主黨支持者的展望也改善，但幅度較溫和；共和黨支持者則轉弱，可能反映他們不樂見白宮政策議程推進速度放慢。
長期通膨預期的下降，則完全由無黨派選民帶動。民主黨支持者的預期與上月持平，共和黨支持者略升。
儘管信心回暖，美國家庭仍承受高物價與高借貸成本壓力，30年期房貸利率自9月中旬以來一直高於7%。持續漲價曾使消費者信心在5月降至歷史低點，10月則落在歷來次低。
Hsu也提醒，即使通膨預期降溫，消費者仍普遍認為，未來一至兩年，通膨造成的生活困難將大於失業問題。
paras_en: U.S. consumer confidence rose in November, and one-year inflation expectations fell by a full percentage point, driven by lower gasoline prices and an improved economic outlook after the midterm elections. The University of Michigan released on Friday (the 20th) that the final November consumer confidence index rose to 51.5, up from 48 in October and the preliminary 51, but slightly below Bloomberg economists' forecast of 51.6.

The survey was conducted from October 20 to November 16, covering the period before and after the U.S. midterm elections. Democrats won control of both chambers of Congress and flipped several state governorships, prompting consumers to adjust their views on future policy and the economic environment.

Inflation expectations cooled sharply, and lower gasoline prices eased household pressure. The survey showed that consumers’ one‑year inflation expectation fell from 4.7% in October to 3.7%, the lowest since February, while five‑ to ten‑year long‑term inflation expectations dropped from 3.5% to 3.3%.

The decline in one‑year inflation expectations mainly reflects a sharp reduction in respondents who expected inflation to exceed 5%. Among them, independent voters’ one‑year expectations fell to the lowest level since February, and Democratic supporters’ expectations fell to a near‑two‑year low. Republican supporters’ expectations rose slightly but remain below earlier levels this year.

Gasoline price cuts provided some breathing room. According to the American Automobile Association (AAA), the national average gasoline price was still above $4 per gallon at the start of the month, but fell to about $3.75 by the end of the survey period.

University of Michigan consumer survey director Joanne Hsu noted that after the election, respondents’ expectations for gasoline prices dropped markedly and are now roughly back to pre‑Iran‑conflict levels.

Consumers’ assessments of current economic conditions and future outlook both improved, and personal‑finance indicators rose to their highest since July. The improvement was most pronounced for low‑asset households, with moderate‑asset households also seeing modest gains; by contrast, respondents with the largest stock holdings reported a decline in personal‑finance assessments, consistent with continued volatility in AI‑related stocks.

Independent voters’ outlook surged, though the public remains most concerned about inflation. Hsu said consumers appear to expect that future executive and legislative control will be split between parties, potentially prompting policy adjustments, which drove the sharp rise in the independent‑voter index.

Democratic supporters also saw their outlook improve, but to a milder degree; Republican supporters’ outlook weakened, possibly reflecting displeasure with a slower pace of the White House policy agenda.

The drop in long‑term inflation expectations was driven entirely by independent voters. Democratic supporters’ expectations held steady with last month, while Republican supporters’ expectations rose slightly.

Despite the confidence rebound, U.S. households still face pressure from high prices and borrowing costs, with 30‑year mortgage rates staying above 7% since mid‑September. Persistent price hikes pushed consumer confidence down to a historic low in May, with October’s reading ranking among the lowest on record.
Hsu also warned that even as inflation expectations cool, consumers generally believe that inflation‑related hardships over the next one to two years will outweigh concerns about unemployment.

items.title: 輝達距高點跌逾4成！近7個交易日蒸發8110億美元 賣壓還沒完？
items.title_en: Nvidia Falls Over 40% From Its Peak! $811 Billion Market Cap Wiped Out in Seven Trading Days, Is the Selling Pressure Over?
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)股價跌勢延續，即使交出強勁財報，仍難挽回市場信心。據《MarketWatch》報導，輝達周五(20日)盤中下跌約5%，正朝連續第七周收黑邁進，恐創2008年7月以來最長周線連跌紀錄，股價較10月初的歷史收盤高點已回落41.2%。
截至報導時，輝達本周累計下跌13.6%。若跌勢維持至收盤，也將連續第七個交易日下跌，這段期間市值已蒸發8,110億美元，接近摩根大通(JPM-US)約8,470億美元的整家公司市值。
根據道瓊市場數據，輝達市值降至約3.338兆美元，低於Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)的3.385兆美元，退居美國上市公司第四位，也是2024年4月以來首次落後Alphabet。
輝達上一次連續七周下跌，要追溯至2008年7月，當時公司發布獲利預警，並忙於處理部分晶片的瑕疵問題。如今，市場面對的則是領導層更替、董事會調查與AI需求能否持續等多重不確定性。
共同創辦人黃仁勳辭任執行長後，董事會正調查其行為是否危及國家安全或洩露公司機密。不過，輝達在這場風波前就已承壓，投資人持續質疑AI需求成長的可持續性。
公司周二公布強勁財報，並上調明年營收展望，仍未能止住跌勢。Catalyst Funds投資長David Miller表示，股價在強勁財報後依然疲弱，凸顯重建市場信心所需克服的挑戰。
Seaport Research分析師Jay Goldberg指出，部分基金經理人過去因為將輝達視為「安全牌」而持有，如今卻在動盪中轉出持股。
對於後市，Goldberg預期股價下周可能趨於穩定。他表示：「我不認為會一直跌下去。」但他也坦言，在下一任執行長人選明朗前，沒有人急著進場買進。
Miller則認為，輝達仍容易遭遇更多拋售，連跌時間有多長，本身並不能透露股價底部在哪裡。
他表示，股價確實可能強勁反彈，但要對持續復甦更有信心，仍須看到正式領導人選與調查進度更加明朗，以及公司持續落實客戶需求與產品交付。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) shares continued to slide, and even a strong earnings report failed to restore market confidence. MarketWatch reported that on Friday the 20th the stock fell about 5% during the session, heading toward a seventh consecutive week of losses, potentially setting a record for the longest weekly losing streak since July 2008, with the price down 41.2% from its early‑October historical closing high.

By the time of the report Nvidia had fallen a cumulative 13.6% this week. If the decline held through the close, it would mark a seventh straight trading day down, erasing about $811 billion in market value – roughly the entire market cap of JPMorgan (JPM‑US) at about $847 billion.

According to Dow Jones market data Nvidia’s market value slipped to roughly $3.338 trillion, falling below Alphabet (GOOGL‑US/GOOG‑US) at $3.385 trillion and dropping to fourth place among U.S. listed companies, the first time since April 2024 it has lagged Alphabet.

The last time Nvidia logged seven consecutive weeks of decline was back in July 2008, when the company issued a profit warning and was busy addressing defects in some chips. Today the market faces multiple uncertainties, including leadership changes, a board investigation and whether AI demand can be sustained.

Co‑founder Jensen Huang stepped down as CEO and the board is probing whether his actions jeopardized national security or leaked company secrets. Nonetheless Nvidia was already under pressure before the scandal, with investors continuously questioning the sustainability of AI demand growth.

The company posted a strong earnings report on Tuesday and raised its revenue outlook for next year, yet the sell‑off persisted. Catalyst Funds’ CIO David Miller said the stock remained weak after the robust results, highlighting the challenges of rebuilding market confidence.
Seaport Research analyst Jay Goldberg noted that some fund managers who previously held Nvidia as a “safe‑play” are now shedding positions amid the turmoil.

Looking ahead, Goldberg expects the stock may stabilize next week. He said, “I don’t think it will keep falling forever,” but admitted that no one is eager to buy until the next CEO candidate is clear.
Miller, however, believes Nvidia remains vulnerable to further selling and cautioned that the length of the decline does not reveal where the bottom lies.

He added that while a strong rebound is possible, confidence in a sustained recovery will require clearer leadership, progress on the investigation, and continued delivery of customer‑driven products.

items.title: AI股賣壓擴大！道瓊盤中跌入修正 那指今年漲幅全吐光
items.title_en: AI Stock Selling Pressure Expands! Dow Slides into Correction Midday, Nasdaq Erases All Gains This Year
paras: 美股周五(20日)盤中跌勢加劇，科技類股單日跌逾5%，本周累計跌幅擴大至10.5%，恐創2025年4月以來最差單周表現。AI相關類股持續遭到拋售，道瓊指數盤中跌入修正區間，那斯達克指數則吐光今年漲幅、轉為下跌，輝達財報與Anthropic掛牌熱潮均未能穩住市場信心。
截稿前，那斯達克綜合指數下跌3.3%，今年以來累計轉跌0.6%；標普500指數下跌2%；道瓊指數下跌262點、跌幅0.5%，較歷史收盤高點回落逾10%，盤中進入修正區間。
Anthropic(ANT-US)掛牌次日下跌11%，回吐部分周四首日上市17%的漲幅，進一步壓抑AI交易。半導體股跌勢尤其猛烈，超微(AMD-US)重挫11%，輝達(NVDA-US)下跌逾7%，美光(MU-US)更大跌逾12%。
據《CNBC》報導，科技類股賣壓在接近午盤時加劇。截至美東時間上午11時57分，單日跌幅超過5%，本周累跌10.5%，可能創2025年4月4日當周以來最大單周跌幅。當周川普政府宣布大規模進口關稅，引發市場震盪。
這波跌勢延續周四的拋售潮，當時三大指數均下跌逾2%，道瓊更自6月以來首次收在5萬點關卡以下。
本周以來，道瓊累計下跌約6%，可能創2025年4月以來最差單周表現；標普500累跌約7%，那斯達克則下跌約8%，兩者也都朝逾一年來最大單周跌幅邁進。
Procyon美股主管Massimo Santicchia表示，這已不只是估值因素驅動的修正，跌勢正在擴大，目前市場明顯轉向避險。
黃仁勳離任輝達後，投資人對AI產業支出前景與債務融資的擔憂進一步加深。市場同時擔心，AI資本支出成長可能放緩，加上聯準會(Fed)未來可能升息，讓相關投資面臨更高資金成本。《CNBC》形容，在接連的負面消息衝擊下，市場似乎正逼近「投降式拋售」階段。
Catalyst Funds投資長David Miller認為，Anthropic首日強勁表現與科技股普遍下跌同時出現，顯示投資人仍相信AI，但對願意為成長支付的價格更加挑剔。
他指出，輝達領導層的不確定性增添另一層風險，而股價即使在強勁財報後仍持續走弱，也凸顯重建市場信心仍面臨相當大的挑戰。
paras_en: U.S. stocks fell faster on Friday (the 20th) mid‑session, with tech stocks dropping over 5% in a single day; the weekly decline widened to 10.5%, potentially the worst weekly performance since April 2025. AI‑related shares kept getting sold off, the Dow entered correction territory mid‑session, and the Nasdaq gave up all its year‑to‑date gains to turn negative, as Nvidia’s earnings and the Anthropic listing frenzy failed to restore market confidence.

By the time of writing, the Nasdaq Composite was down 3.3% and has slipped 0.6% year‑to‑date; the S&P 500 fell 2%; the Dow dropped 262 points, or 0.5%, more than 10% off its historic closing high and moved into correction range during the session.

Anthropic (ANT‑US) fell 11% the day after its debut, erasing part of the 17% surge it posted on Thursday, further pressuring AI trades. Semiconductor stocks fell especially hard, with AMD plunging 11%, Nvidia sliding over 7%, and Micron tumbling more than 12%.

According to CNBC, tech‑stock selling pressure intensified near the noon session. As of 11:57 a.m. Eastern Time, the single‑day decline exceeded 5% and the week‑to‑date drop hit 10.5%, possibly the biggest weekly fall since the week of April 4 2025, when the Trump administration announced large import tariffs that rattled markets.
The decline continued Thursday’s sell‑off, when all three major indices fell more than 2% and the Dow fell below the 50,000‑point mark for the first time since June.

Since the start of the week, the Dow has slid about 6%, potentially the worst weekly performance since April 2025; the S&P 500 is down roughly 7%, and the Nasdaq about 8%, both edging toward their largest weekly drops in over a year.
Procyon U.S. equities head Massimo Santicchia said the pull‑back is no longer just a valuation‑driven correction; the slide is widening and the market is clearly shifting toward safety.

Since Jensen Huang stepped down from Nvidia, investors have grown more worried about AI‑industry spending outlooks and debt financing. The market also fears AI cap‑ex growth may slow and that the Fed could raise rates, raising funding costs. CNBC described the market as approaching a “surrender‑style sell‑off” amid a string of negative news.

Catalyst Funds chief investment officer David Miller said Anthropic’s strong debut amid a broad tech sell‑off shows investors still believe in AI, but they are becoming pickier about the price they’re willing to pay for growth.

He noted that uncertainty around Nvidia’s leadership adds another layer of risk, and the stock’s continued weakness even after a robust earnings report highlights the considerable challenge of rebuilding market confidence.

items.title: AI風暴燒進債市！CoreWeave違約避險成本飆升 Alphabet創新高
items.title_en: AI Storm Sweeps Into the Bond Market! CoreWeave Default‑Hedge Cost Soars, Alphabet Hits Record High
paras: AI交易震盪的衝擊正從股市蔓延至債市。多家大型雲端與晶片業者的信用風險指標周五(20日)上升，企業債價格同步承壓，其中CoreWeave(CRWV-US)的違約避險成本大幅攀升，市場報價隱含的未來五年違約機率超過65%。
根據ICE Data Services數據，CoreWeave五年期信用違約交換(CDS)一度上升76.2基點，達1,232.6基點。CDS是用來轉移債務違約風險的工具，報價升高代表違約避險成本增加；上述隱含違約機率屬於市場定價推算，並非對實際違約結果的確定預測。
甲骨文(ORCL-US)五年期CDS一度上升4.2基點，至327.9基點，創10月20日以來最高。Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)的同類指標則一度攀升3.8基點，至93.7基點，創歷史新高。
輝達(NVDA-US)、SpaceX(SPCX-US)、Meta(META-US)與博通(AVGO-US)的信用風險指標也同步惡化，顯示AI相關企業面臨的市場壓力，已延伸至債務違約避險交易。
近來科技股遭遇猛烈拋售，全球股市正邁向三年來最長連跌紀錄。市場對AI產業前景、地緣政治及利率走向的疑慮升高，也帶動金融市場波動。
賣壓同時波及美國高收益債與投資等級債的次級市場。根據Trace交易資料，截至紐約時間上午10時35分，CoreWeave票面利率9%、2031年到期的債券，每1美元面額報價下跌約2美分，至80美分左右，相當於面額的八成，位居高收益債市場跌幅最大的債券之列。
paras_en: AI‑driven trading turbulence is spreading from equities to the bond market. Credit‑risk indicators for several large cloud and chip firms rose on Friday (the 20th), putting pressure on corporate bond prices, and CoreWeave’s (CRWV‑US) default‑hedge cost jumped sharply, with market‑quoted implied five‑year default probability exceeding 65%.

According to ICE Data Services, CoreWeave’s five‑year credit default swap (CDS) spiked 76.2 basis points to 1,232.6 basis points. A CDS is a tool for transferring debt‑default risk; a higher quote means higher hedging cost. The implied default probability is derived from market pricing, not a definitive forecast of an actual default.

Oracle’s (ORCL‑US) five‑year CDS briefly rose 4.2 basis points to 327.9 basis points, the highest since October 20. Alphabet (GOOGL‑US/GOOG‑US), Google’s parent, saw its comparable metric climb 3.8 basis points to 93.7 basis points, a historic high.

Nvidia (NVDA‑US), SpaceX (SPCX‑US), Meta (META‑US) and Broadcom (AVGO‑US) also saw their credit‑risk indicators deteriorate, showing that market pressure on AI‑related companies has extended to debt‑default‑hedge trading.

Tech stocks have recently faced heavy selling, and global equity markets are on track for the longest consecutive‑decline streak in three years. Growing doubts about the AI sector’s outlook, geopolitical tensions and interest‑rate trajectories have heightened financial‑market volatility.

Selling pressure has also hit the secondary market for U.S. high‑yield and investment‑grade bonds. Trace trade data show that as of 10:35 a.m. New York time, CoreWeave’s 9% coupon bonds maturing in 2031 were quoted about 2 cents lower per $1 face value, around $0.80, roughly 80% of par, making them among the biggest losers in the high‑yield bond market.

items.title: 輝達被Google母公司超車！退居美股市值第四 股價恐連7周收黑
items.title_en: Nvidia Overtaken by Google’s Parent! Falls to Fourth in US Market Cap, Stock May Close Black for a Seventh Straight Week
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)股價跌勢不止，市值遭Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)超車，退居美國上市公司第四位。據《路透》周五(20日)報導，輝達截至報導時下跌約3%，市值降至3.4兆美元，並可能連續第七周收黑，創2008年以來最長周線連跌紀錄。
這波跌勢發生在輝達公布共同創辦人黃仁勳辭任執行長後的首份財報之際。儘管市場高度關注這次業績，財報仍未能化解投資人對領導層更替，以及AI支出能否持續的疑慮。
輝達市值排名下滑，也反映AI交易內部的投資偏好正在轉變。投資人逐漸偏向除了大舉投入AI，同時已有成熟雲端與軟體營收來源支撐的企業。
根據LSEG數據，Alphabet市值約3.44兆美元，超越輝達、排名第三；微軟(MSFT-US)以3.72兆美元位居第二。
被市場視為對AI交易曝險相對較低的蘋果(AAPL-US)，則以5.08兆美元市值穩居榜首，與其他科技巨頭保持明顯差距。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) shares kept sliding, and its market value was overtaken by Google’s parent company Alphabet (GOOGL-US/GOOG-US), dropping to the fourth‑largest US‑listed company. Reuters reported on Friday (the 20th) that Nvidia was down about 3% at the time of reporting, with its market cap falling to $3.4 trillion, and it could record a seventh consecutive week of losses, the longest weekly losing streak since 2008.

The decline came as Nvidia released its first earnings report after co‑founder Jensen Huang stepped down as CEO. Although the market was closely watching the results, the earnings failed to allay investors’ concerns about the leadership change and whether AI spending can be sustained.

Nvidia’s slip in market‑cap ranking also reflects a shift in AI‑focused investment preferences. Investors are increasingly favoring companies that not only pour heavily into AI but also have mature cloud and software revenue streams to support growth.
According to LSEG data, Alphabet’s market cap is about $3.44 trillion, surpassing Nvidia to rank third, while Microsoft (MSFT-US) sits second with a $3.72 trillion valuation.

Apple (AAPL-US), which the market views as having relatively lower exposure to AI‑related risks, remains at the top with a $5.08 trillion market cap, maintaining a clear lead over the other tech giants.

items.title: 史上最大IPO再擴大！Anthropic公開募資935億美元 仍難擋科技股賣壓
items.title_en: Largest IPO in History Expands Again! Anthropic Raises $93.5 Billion in Public Offering, Yet Tech Stock Selling Pressure Persists
paras: Anthropic(ANT-US)周五(20日)宣布，承銷商已全數行使超額配售權，將首次公開發行(IPO)募資規模推升至935億美元；加計同步完成的260億美元私募，總募資達1,195億美元，尚未扣除發行費用。不過，科技股賣壓持續，股價盤前下挫12%。
據《CNBC》報導，Anthropic周三原先透過IPO募得813億美元，已超越SpaceX(SPCX-US)今年6月創下的紀錄；此次追加配售再增加約122億美元。
公司表示，公開發行合計售出11億2,700萬股A類普通股，每股83美元，包括原先的9億8,000萬股，以及承銷商加購的1億4,700萬股。這項俗稱「綠鞋」的超額配售權，讓承銷商能依原IPO條件額外承銷股票。
同步私募則出售N類普通股，價格同為每股83美元，參與者包括超微(AMD-US)、Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)旗下Google、微軟(MSFT-US)、輝達(NVDA-US)等科技企業。
Anthropic周四在那斯達克以111.50美元開出，盤中漲幅逐步收斂，終場收在97.17美元，較發行價上漲約17%。
這場上市案碰上黃仁勳離任輝達、期中選舉選民對科技業的反彈，以及升息恐拖累數兆美元AI基礎建設投資等挑戰，市場情緒仍疲弱。
Anthropic由執行長阿莫戴(Dario Amodei)、妹妹Daniela Amodei等前OpenAI研究人員於2021年創立，旗下Claude模型深受企業用戶關注。兩人向《CNBC》表示，IPO是重要里程碑，但仍只是公司發展旅程的一站。
paras_en: Anthropic (ANT-US) announced on Friday (the 20th) that its underwriters exercised all of their overallotment options, boosting the size of the initial public offering to $93.5 billion; together with a concurrent private placement of $26 billion, total proceeds amount to $119.5 billion before deducting issuance costs. However, selling pressure on tech stocks continued, and the share price fell 12% in pre‑market trading.

According to CNBC, Anthropic had originally raised $81.3 billion through the IPO on Wednesday, already surpassing the record set by SpaceX (SPCX-US) in June this year; the additional overallotment added roughly $12.2 billion.

The company said the public offering sold a total of 1.127 billion Class A common shares at $83 per share, including the original 980 million shares and an extra 147 million shares purchased by the underwriters. This “green‑shoe” overallotment allows the underwriters to sell additional stock under the original IPO terms.
The simultaneous private placement sold Class N common shares at the same price of $83 per share, with participants including AMD, Alphabet’s Google, Microsoft, Nvidia and other technology firms.
Anthropic opened on Nasdaq on Thursday at $111.50, its intraday gains gradually narrowed, and it closed at $97.17, about 17% above the offering price.

The listing came amid challenges such as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s departure, mid‑term election voter backlash against the tech sector, and concerns that rising interest rates could weigh on trillions of dollars of AI infrastructure investment, leaving market sentiment weak.

Anthropic was founded in 2021 by CEO Dario Amodei, his sister Daniela Amodei, and other former OpenAI researchers. Its Claude model has attracted strong interest from enterprise customers. The siblings told CNBC that the IPO is an important milestone but only one stop on the company’s development journey.

items.title: SpaceX旗下Cursor也用中國AI！為何如今考慮逐步停用？
items.title_en: SpaceX's Cursor Also Uses Chinese AI! Why Is It Now Considering Phasing It Out?
paras: 據《CNBC》周五(20日)報導，SpaceX(SPCX-US)旗下AI程式開發平台Cursor已向美國國會議員表示，正因「地緣政治風險」，考慮逐步停用中國開發的開放權重AI模型。Cursor先前以中國AI公司月之暗面(Moonshot AI)的Kimi K2.5為基礎，打造自家程式模型Composer 2，如今相關技術選擇成為美國國會關注焦點。
這項訊息來自美國眾議院國土安全委員會與中國問題特別委員會共同製作的報告。《CNBC》在報告預定周五公布前，獨家取得相關內容。

Cursor採用Kimi打造模型 向國會透露調整計畫

報告指出，Cursor已告知兩個委員會，將研議因應地緣政治風險，逐步停用中國開發的開放權重模型。目前這項調整仍處於研究階段，並未宣布全面停用或提出明確時程。
SpaceX今年6月宣布簽署收購Cursor的正式協議，並於8月完成交易，當時Cursor的隱含股權估值達600億美元。除了提供AI程式開發工具，Cursor也參與SpaceX旗下Grok系列模型的訓練。
這份報告歷經數月調查，檢視中國AI模型如何被納入美國企業的技術系統。除了Cursor，Airbnb(ABNB-US)與DoorDash(DASH-US)也就使用中國AI模型的情況，配合國會調查提供說明。
中國模型今年在全球的使用量快速增加。隨著模型能力提升，美中AI競爭也進一步延伸至企業採用、技術依賴與國家安全等層面。

低成本推動中國模型普及 國會建議擴大聯邦限制

報告認為，成本、客製化能力，以及接近頂尖模型的效能，是中國AI模型受到企業青睞的主要原因。相較之下，美國缺乏能在市場要求的價格與效能之間，提供競爭力的開放權重替代方案。
報告並警告，北京正試圖將這些技術進展轉化為全球市占率，以及使用者對中國模型的長期依賴。
為此，報告建議推動「美國國家級開放權重計畫」，整合公共運算資源、共用評測基礎設施，以及合法取得美國頂尖模型供訓練使用的管道。
報告也主張，在10月公開、禁止聯邦文職機關系統使用DeepSeek的命令基礎上，進一步禁止聯邦資訊系統，以及執行聯邦合約時使用中國開發的AI模型。
此外，華府也關注中國企業透過海外資料中心，遠端使用輝達(NVDA-US)晶片，以及利用「蒸餾」技術，藉既有模型協助訓練新模型的情況。美國商務部工業與安全局(BIS)已於本周一公布一項臨時最終規則，旨在阻止中國企業遠端取得AI晶片運算資源。
針對《CNBC》的置評要求，Cursor、SpaceX與DoorDash未回應，Airbnb拒絕評論；BIS、中國外交部及中國駐英國大使館也未提供回應。
paras_en: According to CNBC on Friday (the 20th), SpaceX's (SPCX-US) AI programming platform Cursor has told U.S. lawmakers that, due to "geopolitical risk," it is considering gradually discontinuing the use of open-weight AI models developed in China. Cursor previously built its own programming model Composer 2 based on Moonshot AI's Kimi K2.5, and this technology choice has now become a focus of congressional attention.

The information comes from a report jointly produced by the House Homeland Security Committee and the Special Committee on China. CNBC obtained the relevant content exclusively before the report’s scheduled Friday release.

The report notes that Cursor has informed the two committees that it will study how to respond to geopolitical risk by gradually phasing out Chinese-developed open-weight models. The adjustment is still in the research stage, with no announcement of a full shutdown or a clear timeline.

SpaceX announced in June that it had signed a definitive agreement to acquire Cursor, completing the transaction in August, at which time Cursor’s implied equity valuation was $60 billion. In addition to providing AI programming tools, Cursor also participates in training SpaceX’s Grok series models.

The report, compiled over several months, examined how Chinese AI models are being incorporated into U.S. companies’ technology stacks. Besides Cursor, Airbnb (ABNB-US) and DoorDash (DASH-US) also provided explanations to congressional investigators regarding their use of Chinese AI models.

Chinese models have seen a rapid increase in global usage this year. As model capabilities improve, the U.S.-China AI competition is extending into corporate adoption, technological dependence, and national security dimensions.

The report attributes the popularity of Chinese AI models among enterprises to low cost, customization ability, and performance close to top-tier models. By contrast, the U.S. lacks open-weight alternatives that can competitively balance price and performance in the market.
The report warns that Beijing is trying to turn these technological advances into global market share and to create long-term user dependence on Chinese models.

To address this, the report recommends launching a "U.S. National Open-Weight Initiative" that would integrate public computing resources, shared benchmarking infrastructure, and lawful channels to obtain top U.S. models for training use.

The report also advocates that, building on the October order prohibiting federal civilian agency systems from using DeepSeek, further bans be placed on federal information systems and on the use of Chinese-developed AI models in the performance of federal contracts.

Additionally, Washington is concerned about Chinese firms using overseas data centers to remotely access NVIDIA (NVDA-US) chips and employing "distillation" techniques to leverage existing models to train new ones. The Department of Commerce’s Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) announced a temporary final rule on Monday aimed at preventing Chinese companies from remotely obtaining AI chip computing resources.

When asked for comment by CNBC, Cursor, SpaceX and DoorDash did not respond, Airbnb declined to comment, and BIS, China’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and the Chinese embassy in the United Kingdom also provided no response.

items.title: 川普想把資料中心留在美國！美企赴海外興建恐遭禁或被課重稅
items.title_en: Trump Wants to Keep Data Centers in the U.S.! U.S. Companies Building Abroad May Face Ban or Heavy Tax
paras: 據《CNBC》報導，美國總統川普周五(20日)在白宮記者會上表示，他打算禁止美國企業在海外興建資料中心，或對赴海外興建的業者課徵「重稅」。這番談話為美國雲端大廠的海外擴張增添變數，川普當場也透露，連幕僚都是頭一次聽他提起這項構想。
川普說：「我們會全力爭取把資料中心留在美國。」談到限制海外建設時，他又說：「我不知道這算不算突發新聞。我連自己的團隊都還沒說過，不過他們現在就在這裡，我這就告訴他們。」他並未說明可能的稅率或實施時程。

對已在海外布局的美國科技業者來說，資料中心蓋在哪裡，關係到能服務哪些客戶。Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)、亞馬遜(AMZN-US)、微軟(MSFT-US)、Meta(META-US)和甲骨文(ORCL-US)都已在美國以外設有資料中心。對雲端服務商而言，就近設點有助於爭取當地客戶，有時也是為了符合當地法規。若川普的構想付諸實施，業者開拓海外市場時，將得把美方限制也納入選址考量。
川普力促業者在美國興建資料中心，但要找到居民支持的地點，也是一道難題。《CNBC》全美經濟調查顯示，64%的登記選民反對在住家方圓10英里(約16公里)內興建AI資料中心，僅13%表示支持。
川普發表上述談話的前一天，才在中國與中國國家主席習近平、俄羅斯總統普丁舉行三方峰會。川普表示，習近平曾就美國在AI領域的表現向他道賀。
paras_en: According to CNBC, U.S. President Donald Trump said at a White House press conference on Friday (the 20th) that he intends to prohibit American companies from building data centers overseas, or to levy a "heavy tax" on firms that do so. The remarks add uncertainty to the overseas expansion plans of major U.S. cloud providers, and Trump disclosed that even his staff were hearing about the idea for the first time.

Trump said, "We will do everything we can to keep data centers in the United States." When discussing restrictions on overseas construction he added, "I don’t know if this is breaking news. I haven’t even told my own team yet, but they’re here right now, so I’m telling them now." He did not specify any possible tax rate or timeline for implementation.

For U.S. tech firms that have already deployed abroad, the location of a data center determines which customers they can serve. Alphabet (GOOGL-US/GOOG-US), Amazon (AMZN-US), Microsoft (MSFT-US), Meta (META-US) and Oracle (ORCL-US) all operate data centers outside the United States. Proximity helps cloud providers win local customers and sometimes is required to meet local regulations. If Trump’s proposal is enacted, companies will have to factor U.S. restrictions into their site‑selection decisions when expanding overseas.

Trump is urging firms to build data centers in the United States, but finding locations with local resident support is a challenge. A CNBC nationwide economic survey shows that 64% of registered voters oppose building AI data centers within a 10‑mile (about 16‑kilometer) radius of their homes, while only 13% are in favor.

The day before Trump made these remarks, he held a trilateral summit in China with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin. Trump said Xi had congratulated him on the United States' performance in the AI field.

items.title: 美中搶AI霸權也有共同底線！川習同意重大軍事行動不能讓AI自主決定
items.title_en: U.S. and China Agree AI Must Not Autonomously Trigger Major Military Actions, Trump and Xi Share Common Ground
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)周五(20日)表示，美國總統川普與中國國家主席習近平已同意，涉及AI的軍事決策必須有人類參與，不得讓AI自主發動重大軍事行動。他同時預期，美國對輝達(NVDA-US)晶片出口的現行政策不會改變，並強調將限制中國企業透過海外資料中心遠端取得先進AI運算資源。
貝森特結束亞洲行返美後接受《CNBC》訪問，將川普與習近平在深圳會面時達成的軍用AI共識，列為此行的重要成果之一。

重大軍事行動須有人類參與 AI競爭不影響安全共識

貝森特在訪談中使用川普政府偏好的「超級智慧(SI)」一詞，強調人類應始終參與相關軍事決策，不能讓這類技術自主決定重大軍事行動。
他表示，美中即使持續爭奪AI領先地位，也不應影響雙方對人類參與及其他安全措施的共識。
「雙方同意，任何重大軍事行動都不能在沒有人類參與的情況下發動，這與競爭無關。」貝森特說。
不過，他也強調，美國AI實驗室必須維持技術領先，並稱這是防範被用於網路攻擊的「危險」中國AI模型的最佳防禦。
貝森特先前曾與中國副總理何立峰會面，推動建立美中AI對話管道，讓雙方能就相關技術威脅相互通報。川普也曾表示，他與習近平討論過AI，兩人都希望對這項技術進行監管。

輝達晶片出口政策料不變 美國收緊遠端存取管道

談到晶片出口，貝森特表示，H200仍是中國在取得許可後，可以購買的最高階輝達AI晶片。他不預期川普政府目前對輝達晶片出口的政策有所改變。
貝森特指出，中國對H200的訂單相當有限，因為中國正努力建立自身的晶片技術體系。他並認為，中國相關技術「可能仍落後多年」。
美國商務部本周一已採取措施，進一步限制中國取得先進AI晶片，包括收緊中國企業透過海外資料中心租用運算資源的管道。相關臨時規則由財政部與白宮國家安全會議主導擬定。
貝森特表示，適當的晶片限制將會到位，遠端存取也將受到限制。
至於黃仁勳相關爭議，貝森特表示，涉及黃仁勳的間諜疑雲並未在川習雙邊會談中被提及。川普先前也表示，未向習近平提起此事。
貝森特上周曾就與黃樂(Alice Huang)有關的Megaspeed International未被列入美國貿易黑名單一事，將矛頭指向商務部。外界也持續檢視商務部長盧特尼克(Howard Lutnick)在阻止先進AI晶片流向中國方面的角色。
但被問及內閣對中國應採取多強硬立場是否存在歧見時，貝森特淡化分歧，強調官員們「都致力遵循川普總統的指示」。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Friday (the 20th) that President Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping have agreed that military decisions involving AI must include human participation and cannot allow AI to autonomously launch major military actions. He also expects the current U.S. policy on exporting Nvidia (NVDA-US) chips to remain unchanged and stressed that China’s firms will be barred from remotely accessing advanced AI computing resources through overseas data centers.
After returning from Asia, Bessent told CNBC that the military AI consensus reached by Trump and Xi during their meeting in Shenzhen was one of the key outcomes of his trip.

Major military actions must involve humans; AI competition does not affect the safety consensus. Bessent used the Trump administration’s preferred term “superintelligence (SI)” in the interview, emphasizing that humans must always be part of related military decisions and that such technology should not be allowed to decide major military actions on its own.
He said that even as the U.S. and China continue to vie for AI leadership, it should not affect the mutual agreement on human involvement and other safety measures.
“Both sides agree that any major military action cannot be launched without human participation; this is unrelated to competition,” Bessent said.
He also stressed that U.S. AI labs must maintain technological leadership, calling it the best defense against “dangerous” Chinese AI models that could be used for cyber attacks.

Bessent previously met with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng to promote an U.S.-China AI dialogue channel so the two sides can exchange information on technology threats. Trump also said he discussed AI with Xi, and both want regulation of the technology.

Regarding chip exports, Bessent said the H200 remains the highest‑end Nvidia AI chip that China can purchase after obtaining a license, and he does not expect the Trump administration to change its current Nvidia export policy.

He noted that China’s orders for the H200 are quite limited because China is working to build its own chip technology ecosystem, and he believes Chinese related technology “may still be years behind.”

The U.S. Commerce Department took action on Monday to further restrict China’s access to advanced AI chips, tightening the channel for Chinese firms to rent computing resources through overseas data centers. The interim rules were drafted by the Treasury and the White House National Security Council.
Bessent said appropriate chip restrictions will be put in place and remote access will also be limited.

On the controversy involving Jensen Huang, Bessent said the espionage allegations surrounding Huang were not raised in the bilateral Trump‑Xi talks. Trump previously also said he did not bring the issue up with Xi.

Last week Bessent blamed the Commerce Department for Megaspeed International, linked to Alice Huang, not being placed on the U.S. trade blacklist. Observers continue to scrutinize Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick’s role in preventing advanced AI chips from flowing to China.

When asked whether there were differing views within the cabinet on how tough a stance toward China should be, Bessent downplayed any split, emphasizing that officials “are all committed to following President Trump’s directives.”

items.title: 美國通膨預期創9個月新低！11月密大消費信心回升 選後展望轉佳
items.title_en: U.S. Inflation Expectations Hit 9-Month Low as November Consumer Confidence Rebounds; Post-Election Outlook Improves
paras: 美國11月消費者信心回升，一年期通膨預期更大降1個百分點，汽油價格下滑與期中選舉後的經濟展望改善，成為主要支撐。密西根大學周五(20日)公布，11月消費者信心指數終值升至51.5，高於10月的48及初值51，但略低於《彭博》調查經濟學家預估的51.6。
這次調查於10月20日至11月16日進行，涵蓋美國期中選舉前後。民主黨贏得國會兩院控制權，並翻轉多州州長席次，消費者對未來政策與經濟環境的看法也隨之調整。

通膨預期明顯降溫 汽油降價減輕家庭壓力

調查顯示，消費者對未來一年的通膨預期，由10月的4.7%降至3.7%，創2月以來最低；未來五至十年的長期通膨預期，也由3.5%降至3.3%。
一年期通膨預期下降，主要反映預估通膨將達5%以上的受訪者明顯減少。其中，無黨派選民的一年期通膨預期降至2月以來最低，民主黨支持者則降至近兩年最低。共和黨支持者的預期略升，但仍低於今年稍早水準。
汽油降價提供部分喘息空間。根據美國汽車協會(AAA)數據，全美平均汽油價格在月初仍高於每加侖4美元，到調查結束時已降至約3.75美元。
密大消費者調查主任Joanne Hsu指出，選後受訪者對汽油價格的預期明顯下降，目前已大致接近伊朗戰事前的水準。
消費者對當前經濟情況與未來展望的評估均改善，個人財務現況指標也升至7月以來最高。低資產家庭改善最明顯，中等資產家庭也有較小幅度的改善；相較之下，股票持有部位最大的受訪者，個人財務評估反而下降，與AI相關股市持續震盪的情況一致。

無黨派選民展望大增 民眾仍最擔心通膨

Hsu表示，消費者似乎預期，未來行政與立法分由不同政黨掌控，可能帶來公共政策調整，因此無黨派選民的預期指數大幅攀升。
民主黨支持者的展望也改善，但幅度較溫和；共和黨支持者則轉弱，可能反映他們不樂見白宮政策議程推進速度放慢。
長期通膨預期的下降，則完全由無黨派選民帶動。民主黨支持者的預期與上月持平，共和黨支持者略升。
儘管信心回暖，美國家庭仍承受高物價與高借貸成本壓力，30年期房貸利率自9月中旬以來一直高於7%。持續漲價曾使消費者信心在5月降至歷史低點，10月則落在歷來次低。
Hsu也提醒，即使通膨預期降溫，消費者仍普遍認為，未來一至兩年，通膨造成的生活困難將大於失業問題。
paras_en: U.S. consumer confidence rose in November, and one-year inflation expectations fell by a full percentage point, driven by lower gasoline prices and an improved economic outlook after the midterm elections. The University of Michigan released on Friday (the 20th) that the final November consumer confidence index rose to 51.5, up from 48 in October and the preliminary 51, but slightly below Bloomberg economists' forecast of 51.6.

The survey was conducted from October 20 to November 16, covering the period before and after the U.S. midterm elections. Democrats won control of both chambers of Congress and flipped several state governorships, prompting consumers to adjust their views on future policy and the economic environment.

Inflation expectations cooled sharply, and lower gasoline prices eased household pressure. The survey showed that consumers’ one‑year inflation expectation fell from 4.7% in October to 3.7%, the lowest since February, while five‑ to ten‑year long‑term inflation expectations dropped from 3.5% to 3.3%.

The decline in one‑year inflation expectations mainly reflects a sharp reduction in respondents who expected inflation to exceed 5%. Among them, independent voters’ one‑year expectations fell to the lowest level since February, and Democratic supporters’ expectations fell to a near‑two‑year low. Republican supporters’ expectations rose slightly but remain below earlier levels this year.

Gasoline price cuts provided some breathing room. According to the American Automobile Association (AAA), the national average gasoline price was still above $4 per gallon at the start of the month, but fell to about $3.75 by the end of the survey period.

University of Michigan consumer survey director Joanne Hsu noted that after the election, respondents’ expectations for gasoline prices dropped markedly and are now roughly back to pre‑Iran‑conflict levels.

Consumers’ assessments of current economic conditions and future outlook both improved, and personal‑finance indicators rose to their highest since July. The improvement was most pronounced for low‑asset households, with moderate‑asset households also seeing modest gains; by contrast, respondents with the largest stock holdings reported a decline in personal‑finance assessments, consistent with continued volatility in AI‑related stocks.

Independent voters’ outlook surged, though the public remains most concerned about inflation. Hsu said consumers appear to expect that future executive and legislative control will be split between parties, potentially prompting policy adjustments, which drove the sharp rise in the independent‑voter index.

Democratic supporters also saw their outlook improve, but to a milder degree; Republican supporters’ outlook weakened, possibly reflecting displeasure with a slower pace of the White House policy agenda.

The drop in long‑term inflation expectations was driven entirely by independent voters. Democratic supporters’ expectations held steady with last month, while Republican supporters’ expectations rose slightly.

Despite the confidence rebound, U.S. households still face pressure from high prices and borrowing costs, with 30‑year mortgage rates staying above 7% since mid‑September. Persistent price hikes pushed consumer confidence down to a historic low in May, with October’s reading ranking among the lowest on record.
Hsu also warned that even as inflation expectations cool, consumers generally believe that inflation‑related hardships over the next one to two years will outweigh concerns about unemployment.

items.title_en: Nvidia Falls Over 40% From Its Peak! $811 Billion Market Cap Wiped Out in Seven Trading Days, Is the Selling Pressure Over?
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)股價跌勢延續，即使交出強勁財報，仍難挽回市場信心。據《MarketWatch》報導，輝達周五(20日)盤中下跌約5%，正朝連續第七周收黑邁進，恐創2008年7月以來最長周線連跌紀錄，股價較10月初的歷史收盤高點已回落41.2%。
截至報導時，輝達本周累計下跌13.6%。若跌勢維持至收盤，也將連續第七個交易日下跌，這段期間市值已蒸發8,110億美元，接近摩根大通(JPM-US)約8,470億美元的整家公司市值。
根據道瓊市場數據，輝達市值降至約3.338兆美元，低於Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)的3.385兆美元，退居美國上市公司第四位，也是2024年4月以來首次落後Alphabet。
輝達上一次連續七周下跌，要追溯至2008年7月，當時公司發布獲利預警，並忙於處理部分晶片的瑕疵問題。如今，市場面對的則是領導層更替、董事會調查與AI需求能否持續等多重不確定性。
共同創辦人黃仁勳辭任執行長後，董事會正調查其行為是否危及國家安全或洩露公司機密。不過，輝達在這場風波前就已承壓，投資人持續質疑AI需求成長的可持續性。
公司周二公布強勁財報，並上調明年營收展望，仍未能止住跌勢。Catalyst Funds投資長David Miller表示，股價在強勁財報後依然疲弱，凸顯重建市場信心所需克服的挑戰。
Seaport Research分析師Jay Goldberg指出，部分基金經理人過去因為將輝達視為「安全牌」而持有，如今卻在動盪中轉出持股。
對於後市，Goldberg預期股價下周可能趨於穩定。他表示：「我不認為會一直跌下去。」但他也坦言，在下一任執行長人選明朗前，沒有人急著進場買進。
Miller則認為，輝達仍容易遭遇更多拋售，連跌時間有多長，本身並不能透露股價底部在哪裡。
他表示，股價確實可能強勁反彈，但要對持續復甦更有信心，仍須看到正式領導人選與調查進度更加明朗，以及公司持續落實客戶需求與產品交付。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) shares continued to slide, and even a strong earnings report failed to restore market confidence. MarketWatch reported that on Friday the 20th the stock fell about 5% during the session, heading toward a seventh consecutive week of losses, potentially setting a record for the longest weekly losing streak since July 2008, with the price down 41.2% from its early‑October historical closing high.

By the time of the report Nvidia had fallen a cumulative 13.6% this week. If the decline held through the close, it would mark a seventh straight trading day down, erasing about $811 billion in market value – roughly the entire market cap of JPMorgan (JPM‑US) at about $847 billion.

According to Dow Jones market data Nvidia’s market value slipped to roughly $3.338 trillion, falling below Alphabet (GOOGL‑US/GOOG‑US) at $3.385 trillion and dropping to fourth place among U.S. listed companies, the first time since April 2024 it has lagged Alphabet.

The last time Nvidia logged seven consecutive weeks of decline was back in July 2008, when the company issued a profit warning and was busy addressing defects in some chips. Today the market faces multiple uncertainties, including leadership changes, a board investigation and whether AI demand can be sustained.

Co‑founder Jensen Huang stepped down as CEO and the board is probing whether his actions jeopardized national security or leaked company secrets. Nonetheless Nvidia was already under pressure before the scandal, with investors continuously questioning the sustainability of AI demand growth.

The company posted a strong earnings report on Tuesday and raised its revenue outlook for next year, yet the sell‑off persisted. Catalyst Funds’ CIO David Miller said the stock remained weak after the robust results, highlighting the challenges of rebuilding market confidence.
Seaport Research analyst Jay Goldberg noted that some fund managers who previously held Nvidia as a “safe‑play” are now shedding positions amid the turmoil.

Looking ahead, Goldberg expects the stock may stabilize next week. He said, “I don’t think it will keep falling forever,” but admitted that no one is eager to buy until the next CEO candidate is clear.
Miller, however, believes Nvidia remains vulnerable to further selling and cautioned that the length of the decline does not reveal where the bottom lies.

He added that while a strong rebound is possible, confidence in a sustained recovery will require clearer leadership, progress on the investigation, and continued delivery of customer‑driven products.

items.title_en: New Taiwan Dollar: Central Bank Strongly Stabilizes, Closes at 32.936, Up 0.6 Points
paras: 台股加權指數今(20)日再度破底，市場出現強烈的去槓桿壓力，單日跌點達2393點，創史上第三大跌點，一周來已跌掉7641點，周跌幅17.5%，台北匯市見到中央銀行全力穩盤調節，新台幣終場收在32.936元，升值0.6分，與股市脫鉤，台北外匯經紀公司成交值則縮至21.02億美元。
新台幣今日以32.96元、貶值1.8分開出後，盤中一度轉升值，午盤過後又見貶值壓力湧出，收盤半小時又轉升，顯示來回拋補的拉鋸力道激烈，但成交量萎縮，全日高低價差1.2角。
觀察主要亞幣，日元強彈超過0.4%，人民幣升0.3%，星元升0.15%上下，泰銖升約0.1%，新台幣收升0.02%，而韓元貶值約0.1%。
法人分析，聯準會官員有提到AI的蓬勃發展正在加劇經濟過熱風險，企業投資達到空前規模但經濟產能未必承受得住，使聯準會將不得不應對短期影響，而這些影響目前看來是推升通膨，在此鷹派聲浪下，暫難見到帶動外資回頭的訊號，使匯市偏弱整理。
paras_en: The Taiwan weighted index broke its low again today (20th), with the market under strong deleveraging pressure. It fell 2,393 points in a single day, the third‑largest point drop in history, and has lost 7,641 points over the past week, a weekly decline of 17.5%. In the Taipei foreign‑exchange market the central bank stepped in forcefully to stabilize the currency; the New Taiwan dollar closed at 32.936, appreciating 0.6 points and decoupling from the equity market. Turnover at Taipei FX brokers shrank to US$2.102 billion.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at 32.96, down 1.8 points, then rose briefly during the session. After the midday break, depreciation pressure resurfaced, but in the half‑hour before close it turned upward again, showing a fierce tug‑of‑war between buying and selling. However, trading volume contracted and the daily high‑low range was only 0.12 yuan.

Among the major Asian currencies, the Japanese yen surged more than 0.4%, the Chinese renminbi rose 0.3%, the Singapore dollar gained about 0.15%, the Thai baht edged up roughly 0.1%, the New Taiwan dollar finished up 0.02%, while the South Korean won depreciated about 0.1%.

Analysts note that Federal Reserve officials have warned that the rapid growth of AI is heightening the risk of an overheated economy. Corporate investment is reaching unprecedented levels, but productive capacity may not keep pace, forcing the Fed to address short‑term impacts that currently appear to be feeding inflation. Amid this hawkish sentiment, there is little sign of foreign capital returning, leaving the FX market in a weak, consolidating stance.

In Japan, September core machinery orders rose 13.4% year‑on‑year, missing expectations but falling 0.3% month‑on‑month, better than forecast. Reuters surveys show most economists expect the Bank of Japan (BOJ) to announce its third rate hike of the year in December and another hike before the end of March 2025. BOJ Governor Ueda told parliament that inflation may be easing gradually, but steady nominal wage growth and higher household income support consumption, which is expected to resume a modest upward trend, hinting at a near‑term hike that could support the yen, keeping USD/JPY around the low of 159.26.

items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Gains Pause as Anthropic IPO Boosts Risk Appetite, Yen Depreciates
paras: 美元週四(19日)兌多數主要貨幣回落，近期漲勢暫歇。人工智慧(AI)公司Anthropic即將掛牌，提振市場風險偏好，削弱美元買盤。不過，聯準會(Fed)官員的鷹派談話與最新會議紀錄，仍使進一步升息的預期支撐美元，美元指數維持在約19個月高點附近。
美股尾盤時段，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.2%，報103.65；歐元兌美元上漲0.2%，報1.1002美元。
美元指數本週觸及2025年4月2日以來最高水準。當時，美國總統川普宣布大規模關稅措施，引發美國資產賣壓。
美元這波漲勢始於11月10日，當時美國通膨數據高於預期，促使投資人提高對聯準會緊縮政策的押注。聯準會理事華勒(Christopher Waller)呼籲採取更積極措施對抗通膨，而10月27日至28日的會議紀錄也顯示，決策官員愈來愈擔心，可能需要進一步緊縮政策。
加拿大豐業銀行首席外匯策略師奧斯本(Shaun Osborne)表示：「美元這段時間已經漲了不少，我認為目前匯價已反映許多利多。」
他指出，美元多頭若要在短期內推升匯價，需要更強的信心或更多利多消息。他並將美元部分回落，歸因於Anthropic首次公開發行(IPO)前，市場風險情緒改善。
Anthropic的IPO定價高於原先行銷區間，帶動週四那斯達克期貨上漲，也提高市場對其上市表現的期待，重新提振AI類股投資情緒。
巴克萊分析師則認為，財政刺激與強勁的AI相關資本支出，反映美國經濟具有韌性，也意味經濟產出高於潛在水準的幅度可能擴大，利率將在更長時間內維持高檔，這些因素均有利美元。
儘管近期科技股遭到拋售，美元仍獲得資金流入支撐。德意志銀行追蹤逾100檔在美國境外註冊的指數股票型基金(ETF)發現，外國投資人過去兩週大舉逢低買進美股，買進力道為今年最強，顯示流向美股的資金也是支撐美元的重要因素。
隨著風險偏好回升、避險需求降溫，日元兌美元走貶。美元兌日元上漲0.4%，報159.905日元兌1美元，中止連續四個交易日下跌。
分析師指出，若AI相關資產再度遭到拋售，避險買盤與資金匯回日本可能支撐日元，但日元兌其他貨幣的升勢，可能比兌美元更為明顯。
澳幣兌美元則大致持平。澳洲10月就業人數連續第二個月減少，失業率升至五年高點，強化市場對當地利率可能已觸頂的看法。
三菱日聯金融集團(MUFG)資深外匯分析師 Lee Hardman表示，市場大幅上調對聯準會升息的預期，正對大宗商品價格及相關貨幣形成壓力。
瑞銀考量澳洲通膨仍高，以及勞動與房市情況惡化，將澳洲央行首次降息時間預測，由明年11月提前至8月，並將預估降息次數由兩次增加至三次。
英鎊兌美元升值0.1%，報1英鎊兌1.3162美元，但英鎊兌歐元則從20個月高點回落。投資人仍看好英國利率前景，同時對歐洲2027年多場重要選舉可能為歐元帶來的阻力保持警戒。
加密貨幣方面，受風險偏好改善帶動，比特幣上漲2.5%，報63,870美元，脫離上週日觸及的四個月低點62,026美元。

paras_en: The dollar fell against most major currencies on Thursday (the 19th), pausing its recent rally. The upcoming IPO of AI company Anthropic lifted market risk appetite and weakened dollar buying pressure. However, hawkish comments from Federal Reserve officials and the latest meeting minutes still support expectations of further rate hikes, keeping the dollar index near a 19‑month high.
In the late‑day US equity session, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, slipped 0.2% to 103.65, while the euro rose 0.2% to $1.1002.
The dollar index this week reached its highest level since April 2, 2025, when President Trump announced large‑scale tariff measures that triggered selling pressure on US assets.

The current dollar rally began on November 10, when US inflation data came in above expectations, prompting investors to increase bets on tighter Fed policy. Fed Governor Christopher Waller called for more aggressive action against inflation, and the minutes from the Oct. 27‑28 meeting showed policymakers growing increasingly concerned that further tightening may be needed.

Shaun Osborne, chief FX strategist at Canada’s BMO Capital Markets, said: “The dollar has already risen a lot in recent weeks, and I think the current exchange rates already reflect much of the upside.”

He added that for dollar bulls to push rates higher in the short term they would need stronger conviction or more positive news, and he attributed the dollar’s partial pullback to improved market risk sentiment ahead of Anthropic’s IPO.
Anthropic’s IPO was priced above its initial marketing range, lifting Nasdaq futures on Thursday and raising expectations for its market debut, which revived sentiment toward AI‑related stocks.

Barclays analysts argue that fiscal stimulus and robust AI‑related capital spending show the US economy is resilient, suggesting output may be running above potential for longer, keeping rates high – a backdrop that benefits the dollar.

Despite recent tech‑stock sell‑offs, the dollar continued to attract inflows. Deutsche Bank, tracking over 100 offshore‑registered ETFs, found foreign investors bought US equities in large volumes over the past two weeks – the strongest buying this year – indicating that capital flowing into US stocks also underpins the dollar.
With risk appetite recovering and hedging demand easing, the yen weakened against the dollar. The USD/JPY rose 0.4% to 159.905 yen per dollar, ending a four‑day decline.

Analysts note that if AI‑related assets face another sell‑off, safe‑haven buying and capital returning to Japan could support the yen, but the yen’s gains against other currencies may be more pronounced than against the dollar.

The Australian dollar was roughly flat versus the US dollar. October employment in Australia fell for the second consecutive month, pushing the unemployment rate to a five‑year high and reinforcing market views that local rates may have peaked.
Lee Hardman, senior FX analyst at MUFG, said the market’s sharp upgrade of expectations for Fed rate hikes is putting pressure on commodity prices and related currencies.

UBS, considering still‑elevated Australian inflation and worsening labour and housing conditions, moved its forecast for the Reserve Bank of Australia’s first rate cut from November next year to August and increased the expected number of cuts from two to three.

The pound rose 0.1% to $1.3162, but the GBP/EUR slipped from a 20‑month peak. Investors remain bullish on UK rate prospects while staying cautious about the potential drag on the euro from several major European elections slated for 2027.
In crypto, improved risk appetite lifted Bitcoin 2.5% to $63,870, pulling it out of the four‑month low of $62,026 hit last Sunday.

paras: 台北股匯市遭逢雙殺壓力，除了金管會自明(20)日起再祭出五大穩定股市措施，包括重啟「有條件禁空令」，中央銀行也積極調節匯市波動，終場收在32.942元，升值0.5分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值則縮至22.63億美元。
新台幣今日以32.96元、貶值1.3分開出後，最低一度貶至33.04元，但觸及33元心理大關後貶勢並未擴大，收盤前15分鐘更轉升，收在32.942元，高低價差1.2角。
由於成交值較昨日見收斂，法人解讀資金拋補大鬥法已稍微緩解，不過，尚未見到台股的止跌訊號，匯市能否就此守住無形的33元防線，仍受到市場密切關注。
觀察主要亞幣，日元貶值約0.3%，新台幣收升0.02%，星元和人民幣微幅波動不到0.05%，韓元升0.1%左右，泰銖升0.2%，而美元指數小跌近0.1%。
法人指出，聯準會內部鷹派釋出12月應考慮升息2碼的訊息，令市場風險意識持續提高，同時，後黃仁勳時代的AI投資焦慮高漲，AI估值調整壓力持續消化中。
值得留意的是，獨立新創AI Anthropic將在台灣時間今日晚上掛牌，掛牌行情成另一個左右市場信心的重要焦點。
paras_en: Taipei stock and forex markets faced double‑kill pressure. Starting today (20th), the Financial Supervisory Commission rolled out five major measures to stabilise the stock market, including re‑instating the "conditional short‑selling ban". The central bank also actively adjusted FX market volatility, ending the session at 32.942, up 0.5 points, while the turnover of Taipei foreign‑exchange brokerage firms shrank to $2.263 billion.

The New Taiwan dollar opened today at 32.96, down 1.3 points, fell to a low of 33.04, but after hitting the psychological 33‑level the decline did not deepen. In the last 15 minutes before close it turned higher, finishing at 32.942, with a daily range of 1.2 jiao.

Because turnover narrowed compared with yesterday, institutional investors interpret that the large‑scale fund‑outflow battle has eased somewhat, yet no clear bottoming signal has appeared for the Taiwan stock market. Whether the FX market can now hold the intangible 33‑level barrier remains under close market scrutiny.

Looking at major Asian currencies, the Japanese yen weakened about 0.3%, the New Taiwan dollar rose 0.02%, the Singapore dollar and the Chinese yuan fluctuated less than 0.05%, the Korean won rose roughly 0.1%, the Thai baht rose 0.2%, while the US dollar index slipped nearly 0.1%.

Institutions note that hawkish voices inside the Fed have signalled that a 20‑basis‑point rate hike should be considered in December, raising market risk awareness. At the same time, AI‑investment anxiety is soaring in the post‑Jensen Huang era, and pressure from AI valuation adjustments continues to be digested.
Worth noting is that the independent AI startup Anthropic will list tonight Taiwan time, and its debut price will become another key focus influencing market confidence.

週三英國公布10月消費者物價指數(CPI)較上年同期漲3.6%，創一年新高，但核心與服務業價格通貨膨脹率兩項基礎指標年率分別持穩於2.8%及3.7%，不及預期將上升，降低英國央行(BOE)下月升息的概率，打擊英鎊兌美元自1.3212高點下滑。隨著BOE總裁貝利稱，英國勞動力市場似乎不再趨鬆，但存在一定程度的閒置，擴大英鎊兌美元跌幅至1.3132低點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於1.3150-70，支撐於1.3060-80。

U.S. October retail sales showed modest growth and import price increases exceeded expectations, strengthening market bets that the Federal Reserve will tighten monetary policy further in December. Meanwhile, tech giant Nvidia shed recent volatility and posted better‑than‑expected sales forecasts, boosting equities on Wednesday and keeping the dollar near a 19‑month high. Japan’s October trade deficit narrowed sharply to ¥476.5 billion, with imports and exports up 21.6% and 20.5% year‑on‑year respectively, both hitting record monthly levels. Strong global investment continues to support demand for semiconductor‑related products, driving export growth for the 14th consecutive month. BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda told parliament that, given the still‑accommodative financial environment, rate hikes should continue, emphasizing the need to keep core inflation near the 2% target and to adjust monetary easing appropriately as the economy, prices and financial conditions evolve, providing support for the yen and pulling USD/JPY down to a low of 159.11.

Subsequent U.S. October data showed that building permits – a leading indicator of future construction activity – fell 7.4% to an annualized 1.295 million units, while housing starts rose 9.9% to an annualized 1.309 million, beating forecasts. The NAHB survey reported the October existing‑home‑sales‑to‑inventory index slipped 4.7% to 63, the lowest since the series began in 2001. Fed governors Waller and Bahl expressed that more aggressive action is needed to combat inflation, and the Fed’s October meeting minutes revealed that policymakers unanimously agreed to keep rates unchanged for now, though some members suggested a 50‑basis‑point hike, lifting USD/JPY to a high of 159.65. The dollar‑yen pair is expected to face resistance at 159.50‑70 and support at 158.60‑80 today.
EUR/USD

Australia’s Q3 wage‑price index rose 1.1% yesterday, the biggest gain since the end of 2023, indicating a still‑tight labour market. The data are lagging and have not yet reflected the impact of the fifth rate hike this month. In the interest‑rate swap market, the probability of the Reserve Bank of New Zealand raising rates by 25 bps is seen at 80%, with a cumulative 85 bps increase priced in for the end of next year. Conversely, the odds that Australia’s rates have peaked are estimated at 73%, with about 24 bps of cuts priced in for the end of next year. These dynamics have pushed the Australian dollar toward a ten‑month low and the New Zealand dollar to its lowest since March 2020, weighing on the euro‑dollar pair, which is capped by a ceiling at 1.0999.

Four sources disclosed that ECB policymakers plan to discuss raising the minimum reserve requirement for euro‑area banks to 2% next week. The ECB’s financial‑stability report noted that market pressure should prompt France to take self‑disciplinary measures on its high‑debt issue, signalling no rush to intervene in member‑state debt problems, which has pushed EUR/USD down to a low of 1.0952. The pair is expected to face resistance at 1.0975‑95 and support at 1.0900‑20 today.

The UK released its October CPI on Wednesday, up 3.6% year‑on‑year – a one‑year high – while core inflation and services price inflation held steady at 2.8% and 3.7% respectively, below expectations of a rise. The pound‑dollar pair is expected to face resistance at 1.3150‑70 and support at 1.3060‑80 today.

paras: 美元週三(18日)週三走強，升至19個月來新高，受到美國聯準會(Fed)官員華勒(Christopher Waller)的鷹派談話，以及近期經濟數據影響，市場對下個月升息的預期更加確立。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.2%，報103.78，創2025年4月以來最高。
聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)拒絕提供未來政策指引，使投資人更加依賴經濟數據，以及其他決策官員的談話，來判斷聯準會下一步動向。
華勒接受CNBC訪問時表示，如果央行希望降低通膨，就必須採取更「積極的行動」，包括在12月會議升息半個百分點，或是在會後聲明中引導市場預期，為進一步升息做好準備。
上週公布的通膨數據高於預期，使市場完全反映聯準會12月升息25個基點的預期，同時認為升息50個基點仍存在小幅可能性。芝商所(CME Group)FedWatch工具顯示，週二公布數據指出，美國10月零售銷售溫和成長，進一步強化市場對下個月升息的預期。
Monex USA駐華盛頓交易部門資深總監Juan Perez表示，「目前聯準會似乎非常堅定的準備升息，甚至可能採取更激進的升息方式。」
Perez指出，「這正是目前支撐美元走強的市場信念。」

paras_en: The dollar strengthened on Wednesday (the 18th), reaching a 19‑month high, boosted by hawkish comments from Fed official Christopher Waller and recent economic data, solidifying market expectations of a rate hike next month.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.2% to 103.78, the highest since April 2025.
Fed Chair Kevin Warsh refused to provide forward guidance, causing investors to rely more on economic data and remarks from other policymakers to gauge the Fed’s next move.

In a CNBC interview, Waller said that if the central bank wants to bring inflation down, it must take more “aggressive action,” including a 0.5‑percentage‑point rate hike at the December meeting or guiding market expectations in the post‑meeting statement to prepare for further hikes.

Last week’s inflation data came in hotter than expected, leading the market to fully price in a 25‑basis‑point Fed hike in December while still seeing a small chance of a 50‑basis‑point increase. CME Group’s FedWatch tool showed that Tuesday’s data, which reported modest growth in U.S. retail sales for October, further reinforced expectations of a rate hike next month.
Juan Perez, senior director of Monex USA’s Washington trading desk, said, “The Fed now appears very resolute in preparing to raise rates, and may even adopt a more aggressive tightening path.”
Perez added, “That is the market belief currently underpinning the dollar’s strength.”
However, strategists warned that for the dollar to keep climbing, a new bullish catalyst may be needed.

Dilin Wu, a strategist at Pepperstone, said, “To push the dollar significantly higher from current levels, the market may need to start pricing in a more aggressive rate‑hike trajectory through 2027.”

CME’s FedWatch tool shows traders expect the Fed’s benchmark rate to be about 75 basis points higher in 12 months, landing in the 4.50%‑4.75% range. Investors will also watch later remarks from New York Fed President John Williams, Fed Governor Michael Barr, and Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari to gauge the central bank’s next policy step.
The dollar’s rally has pushed other major currencies toward multi‑month lows.
The euro fell 0.2% against the dollar to $1.09735, briefly touching its lowest level since April 2025.
The pound slipped 0.3% to $1.3165, a one‑month low. Data showed Britain’s core inflation for October held steady month‑over‑month, easing market expectations of an imminent BoE rate hike.

The yen was roughly flat at ¥159.29 per dollar. Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda reiterated that monetary policy still needs further tightening. The yen remains near the level the Japanese government intervened at in July this year to support the weak currency.

Markets also focused on the three‑way summit scheduled for Thursday in Shenzhen, attended by U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping, and Russian President Vladimir Putin. The talks could cover Russia’s war in Ukraine, the Iran conflict, as well as trade, AI and nuclear issues.

items.title: 美股牛市還能跑多久？高盛：2027年再漲17% 標普上看8700點 但最強獲利成長階段已過
items.title_en: How Long Can the US Bull Market Run? Goldman Sachs: 17% Rise by 2027, S&P 500 Target 8,700 Points
paras: 高盛最新預測，美股牛市將延續至2027年，但回報率將較前幾年降溫，標普500指數明年底有望上看8700點，較目前水準上漲約17%，低於過去四年21%的年化報酬率。
高盛美股策略首席分析師Ben Snider在最新研究報告中表示，企業獲利成長仍是股市主要支撐，但隨著AI相關資本支出逐漸放緩，獲利增速也將回落。
Snider在報告中指出，標普成分股企業獲利增速將從2026年的30%降至2027年的18%，並可能持續放緩至2028年。「我們預估，隨著企業獲利成長放緩，2027年股票回報率也將有所回落。」
儘管如此，高盛認為目前美股估值仍屬合理。標普今年來持續刷新歷史高點，企業獲利快速成長使本益比倍數下降，目前指數預期本益比約18倍，待第三季財報全數公布後，標普500成分股企業可望連三季實現超過25%的獲利增長。
不過，2027年市場仍面臨兩大壓力：利率可能進一步走升，以及AI投資前景的不確定性，兩者皆可能限制股價上行空間。
Snider指出，企業獲利前景是2027年美股展望的最大變數。在悲觀情境下，若標普獲利預期回落至過去30年趨勢水準，同時本益比降至30年平均17倍，可能下跌約23%至5600點附近。反之，若AI資本支出週期比預期更強勁，或生產率成長超乎預期，推動獲利前景進一步改善，標普到2027年底可望上漲近30%至9400點。AI投資的持續性與實際回報，將決定下一階段美股表現。
產業配置上，高盛預估超大規模雲端企業將繼續受惠AI投資週期，長期大規模回購股票的「回購貴族」也有望表現突出。
值得注意的是，能源基礎設施供應商可能成為2027年獲利增長加速最明顯的群體之一，隨著AI相關基建持續推進，這類企業獲利前景可望改善。
此外，高盛建議關注醫療保健與必需消費品行業，這些類股能提供不同於科技股的配置選擇，在市場波動加劇時發揮分散風險的作用。
根據高盛判斷，2027年美股仍有望延續牛市，但驅動力將從AI資本開支帶動的高速增長，轉向更廣泛的企業獲利改善。對投資人而言，AI熱潮能否真正轉化為生產率提升與利潤增長，將決定標普最終趨近8700點的基準目標，或是向9400點的樂觀情境邁進。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs’ latest forecast suggests the US bull market will continue until 2027, but returns will cool off compared to previous years. The S&P 500 is expected to reach about 8,700 points by the end of next year, a rise of roughly 17% from current levels, below the 21% annualized return of the past four years.

Goldman Sachs’ U.S. equity strategy chief analyst Ben Snider said in a new research report that corporate earnings growth remains the main support for the market, but as AI‑related capital spending slows, earnings growth will also decline.

Snider noted that earnings growth for S&P component companies is projected to fall from 30% in 2026 to 18% in 2027, and may continue to slow into 2028. ‘We expect that as corporate earnings growth slows, the 2027 stock return rate will also decline,’ he said.

Despite this, Goldman Sachs believes current U.S. equity valuations remain reasonable. The S&P has been breaking historical highs this year, and rapid earnings growth has lowered the price‑to‑earnings multiple to about 18×. After the full Q3 earnings are released, S&P component companies could achieve more than 25% earnings growth for three consecutive quarters.
However, the market will still face two major pressures in 2027: rates could rise further, and the uncertainty around AI investment prospects could limit upside potential.

Snider pointed out that corporate earnings prospects are the biggest variable for the 2027 U.S. equity outlook. In a pessimistic scenario, if S&P earnings expectations fall to the 30‑year trend level and the P/E ratio drops to the 30‑year average of 17×, the index could fall about 23% to around 5,600 points. Conversely, if AI capital spending cycles are stronger than expected or productivity growth exceeds expectations, pushing earnings prospects further, the S&P could rise nearly 30% to 9,400 points by the end of 2027. The sustainability and actual return of AI investment will determine the next phase of U.S. equity performance.

In terms of sector allocation, Goldman Sachs expects ultra‑large cloud companies to continue benefiting from the AI investment cycle, and long‑term large‑scale share‑repurchase “buy‑back aristocrats” are also likely to perform strongly.

Notably, energy infrastructure suppliers could become one of the most obvious groups to accelerate earnings growth in 2027, as AI‑related infrastructure continues to advance and improve the earnings outlook for these firms.

Additionally, Goldman Sachs recommends paying attention to healthcare and consumer staples, as these sectors offer a different allocation choice from tech stocks and can provide risk diversification when market volatility intensifies.

According to Goldman Sachs’ assessment, the U.S. equity market can still continue its bull run in 2027, but the driving force will shift from high‑growth AI capital spending to broader corporate earnings improvement. For investors, whether the AI boom can truly translate into productivity gains and profit growth will determine whether the S&P ultimately approaches the 8,700‑point target or moves toward the optimistic 9,400‑point scenario.
